   1| |import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
   3|▼|function replaceInFile(file, search, replacement, options = {}){
   4| |  if (!existsSync(file)) {
   5| |    console.warn(`Skip missing file: ${file}`);
   6| |    return;
   7| |  }
   9| |  let content = readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  11| |  if (options.regex) {
  12| |    if (!search.test(content)) {
  13| |      console.warn(`Pattern not found in ${file}`);
  14| |      return;
  15| |    }
  17| |    content = content.replace(search, replacement);
  18| |  } else {
  19| |    if (!content.includes(search)) {
  20| |      console.warn(`Text not found in ${file}`);
  21| |      return;
  22| |    }
  24| |    content = content.replace(search, replacement);
  25| |  }
  27| |  writeFileSync(file, content);
  28| |  console.log(`Patched ${file}`);

   1| |/**
   2| | * Minimal functional core used by the compiler.
   3| | *
   4| | * This intentionally removes unused utility-belt code and external dependencies.
   5| | * If you need debounce/throttle/memoize/retry, add them in a separate optional
   6| | * module and do not import them into core runtime paths.
   7| | */
   9|▼|export type Result<T, E = string> =
  10| |  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
  11| |  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
  13|▼|export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T, never> => ({ ok: true, value });
  15|▼|export const err = <E>(error: E): Result<never, E> => ({ ok: false, error });
  17| |export const isOk = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: true; value: T } => r.ok;
  19| |export const isErr = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: false; error: E } => !r.ok;
  21|▼|export const unwrapOr =
  22| |  <T>(fallback: T) =>
  23| |  (r: Result<T>): T =>
  24| |    r.ok ? r.value : fallback;
  26|▼|export const unwrapOrElse =
  27| |  <T, E>(fn: (e: E) => T) =>
  28| |  (r: Result<T, E>): T =>
  29| |    r.ok ? r.value : fn(r.error);
  31|▼|export const mapResult =
  32| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  33| |  <E>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  34| |    r.ok ? ok(fn(r.value)) : r;
  36|▼|export const flatMapResult =
  37| |  <T, U, E>(fn: (x: T) => Result<U, E>) =>
  38| |  (r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  39| |    r.ok ? fn(r.value) : r;
  41|▼|export const mapErr =
  42| |  <E, F>(fn: (e: E) => F) =>
  43| |  <T>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<T, F> =>
  44| |    r.ok ? r : err(fn(r.error));
  46|▼|export const tryCatch = <T>(fn: () => T): Result<T, unknown> => {
  47| |  try {
  48| |    return ok(fn());
  49|!|  } catch (error) {
  50| |    return err(error);
  51| |  }
  52| |};
  54|▼|export const tryCatchAsync = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<Result<T, unknown>> => {
  55| |  try {
  56| |    return ok(await fn());
  57|!|  } catch (error) {
  58| |    return err(error);
  59| |  }
  60| |};
  62|▼|export const tryCatchOr = <T>(fallback: T, fn: () => T): T => {
  63| |  try {
  64| |    return fn();
  65| |  } catch {
  66| |    return fallback;
  67| |  }
  68| |};
  70|▼|export type Task<T> = () => Promise<T>;
  72|▼|export const taskMap =
  73| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  74| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  75| |  async () =>
  76| |    fn(await task());
  78|▼|export const taskChain =
  79| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => Task<U>) =>
  80| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  81| |  async () =>
  82| |    fn(await task())();
  84|▼|export const taskFromResult =
  85| |  <T>(value: T): Task<T> =>
  86| |  async () =>
  87| |    value;
  89|▼|export const pipe =
  90| |  <A>(a: A) =>
  91| |  <B>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>): B =>
  92| |    fns.reduce((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a) as unknown as B;
---

>src/compiler/logger.ts
e:Logger|silentLogger|consoleLogger|jsonLogger
f:consoleLogger(verbose = false):Logger
f:jsonLogger(verbose = false):Logger
t:Logger
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Logger
   3| | * All side-effecting I/O is centralized here. Compiler phases receive a Logger
   4| | * interface and remain pure except for logging calls.
   5| | */
   7|▼|export interface Logger {
   8| |  debug(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   9| |  info(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  10| |  warn(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  11| |  error(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  12| |  /** Time a phase and log duration. */
  13| |  time<T>(label: string, fn: () => T): T;
  14| |}
  16| |/** No-op logger for tests and silent mode. */
  17| |export const silentLogger: Logger = {
  18| |  debug: () => {},
  19| |  info: () => {},
  20| |  warn: () => {},
  21| |  error: () => {},
  22| |  time: (_, fn) => fn(),
  23| |};
  25| |/** Console logger with emoji prefixes and structured metadata. */
  26|▼|export const consoleLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  27| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  28| |    if (verbose) console.log(`[debug] ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  29| |  },
  30| |  info(msg, meta) {
  31| |    console.log(`ℹ️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  32| |  },
  33| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  34| |    console.warn(`⚠️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  35| |  },
  36| |  error(msg, meta) {
  37| |    console.error(`❌ ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  38| |  },
  39| |  time(label, fn) {
  40| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  41| |    const result = fn();
  42| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  43| |    console.log(`⏱️  ${label} completed in ${elapsed}ms`);
  44| |    return result;
  45| |  },
  46| |});
  48| |/** Enterprise-grade JSON logger for CI/CD pipelines. */
  49|▼|export const jsonLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  50| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  51| |    if (verbose) console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "debug", msg, ...meta }));
  52| |  },
  53| |  info(msg, meta) {
  54| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "info", msg, ...meta }));
  55| |  },
  56| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  57| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "warn", msg, ...meta }));
  58| |  },
  59| |  error(msg, meta) {
  60| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "error", msg, ...meta }));
  61| |  },
  62| |  time(label, fn) {
  63| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  64| |    const result = fn();
  65| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  66| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "metric", phase: label, durationMs: parseFloat(elapsed) }));
  67| |    return result;
  68| |  },
  69| |});
---

>src/compiler/phases/schema-loader.ts
i:node:url
e:loadRouteModule|isStandardSchema|cloneSchema
f:loadRouteModule(
  absPath: string
):Promise<any | undefined>|a
f:isStandardSchema(value: unknown):boolean
f:cloneSchema(value: unknown):any
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Build-time route schema loader.
   3| | *
   4| | * Phase 2:
   5| | * - dynamically imports route modules
   6| | * - extracts exported schema
   7| | * - caches module loads
   8| | */
  10| |import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
  12| |const moduleCache = new Map<string, unknown>();
  14|▼|export const loadRouteModule = async (
  15| |  absPath: string
  16| |): Promise<any | undefined> => {
  17| |  if (moduleCache.has(absPath)) {
  18| |    return moduleCache.get(absPath);
  19| |  }
  21| |  try {
  22| |    const url = pathToFileURL(absPath).href;
  23| |    const mod: any = await import(url);
  25| |    const handler = mod?.default;
  26| |    const inlineSchema =
  27| |      handler != null && typeof handler === "object" && "schema" in handler
  28| |        ? handler.schema
  29| |        : typeof handler === "function" && "schema" in handler
  30| |          ? handler.schema
  31| |          : undefined;
  33| |    const schema = mod?.schema ?? inlineSchema;
  34| |    const normalized = schema === undefined ? mod : { ...mod, schema };
  36| |    moduleCache.set(absPath, normalized);
  37| |    return normalized;
  38| |  } catch {
  39| |    moduleCache.set(absPath, undefined);
  40| |    return undefined;
  41| |  }
  42| |};
  44|▼|export const isStandardSchema = (value: unknown): boolean => {
  45| |  return (
  46| |    typeof value === "object" &&
  47| |    value !== null &&
  48| |    "~standard" in value
  49| |  );
  50| |};
  52|▼|export const cloneSchema = (value: unknown): any => {
  53| |  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  54| |};

>src/compiler/utils/hash.ts
e:fnv1a|computeSignatureHash
f:fnv1a(str: string):number
f:computeSignatureHash(methodIdx: number, path: string):number
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Hash utilities used by route analysis.
   3| | *
   4| | * Removed:
   5| | * - canUseDenseArray
   6| | * - generatePerfectHash
   7| | * - segmentHash
   8| | *
   9| | * These belonged to the unused jump-table optimizer path.
  10| | */
  12|▼|export const fnv1a = (str: string): number => {
  13| |  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  15| |  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
  16| |    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
  17| |    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  18| |  }
  20| |  return hash >>> 0;
  21| |};
  23|▼|export const computeSignatureHash = (methodIdx: number, path: string): number => {
  24| |  const pathHash = fnv1a(path);
  25| |  return ((methodIdx & 0x07) << 29) | (pathHash >>> 3);
  26| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Lazy body parsing for production performance.
   3| | *
   4| | * Body parsing is deferred until actually needed.
   5| | * Uses Bun-native parsers:
   6| | * - req.json()
   7| | * - req.text()
   8| | * - req.formData()
   9| | * - req.arrayBuffer()
  10| | */
  12|▼|export class BodyParseError extends Error {
  13| |  constructor(
  14| |    message: string,
  15| |    public status = 400
  16| |  ) {
  17| |    super(message);
  18| |    this.name = "BodyParseError";
  19| |  }
  20| |}
  22|▼|export interface LazyBodyOptions {
  23| |  maxJsonBytes?: number;
  24| |  maxTextBytes?: number;
  25| |  maxFormBytes?: number;
  26| |  maxFileBytes?: number;
  27| |}
  29|▼|type BodyKind =
  30| |  | "none"
  31| |  | "json"
  32| |  | "text"
  33| |  | "formData"
  34| |  | "arrayBuffer"
  35| |  | "blob";
  37|▼|export interface LazyBody {
  38| |  (): Promise<unknown>;
  40| |  json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T>;
  41| |  text(): Promise<string>;
  42| |  form(): Promise<Record<string, string>>;
  43| |  multipart(): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  44| |  formData(): Promise<FormData>;
  46| |  file(name?: string): Promise<File | null>;
  47| |  files(name?: string): Promise<File[]>;
  49| |  arrayBuffer(): Promise<ArrayBuffer>;
  50| |  blob(): Promise<Blob>;
  52| |  /**
  53| |   * Returns the raw request stream if the body has not been consumed.
  54| |   * Useful for proxying or streaming uploads downstream.
  55| |   */
  56| |  stream(): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null;
  58| |  readonly consumed: boolean;
  59| |  readonly parsed: unknown;
  60| |}
  62| |const DEFAULT_LIMITS = {
  63| |  maxJsonBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  64| |  maxTextBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  65| |  maxFormBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  66| |  maxFileBytes: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
  67| |};
  69|▼|const forEachFormDataEntry = (
  70| |  fd: FormData,
  71| |  cb: (value: unknown, key: string) => void,
  72| |): void => {
  73| |  const forEach = (fd as unknown as { forEach?: unknown }).forEach;
  75| |  if (typeof forEach === "function") {
  76| |    (forEach as (cb: (value: unknown, key: string) => void) => void).call(
  77| |      fd,
  78| |      cb,
  79| |    );
  80| |  }
  81| |};
  83|▼|const getFormDataEntry = (fd: FormData, name: string): unknown => {
  84| |  const get = (fd as unknown as { get?: unknown }).get;
  86| |  if (typeof get !== "function") {
  87| |    return null;
  88| |  }
  90| |  return (get as (name: string) => unknown).call(fd, name);
  91| |};
  93|▼|const getAllFormDataEntries = (fd: FormData, name: string): unknown[] => {
  94| |  const getAll = (fd as unknown as { getAll?: unknown }).getAll;
  96| |  if (typeof getAll !== "function") {
  97| |    return [];
  98| |  }
 100|▼|  const values = (getAll as (name: string) => unknown).call(fd, name);
 102| |  return Array.isArray(values) ? values : [];
 103| |};
 105|▼|const isFile = (value: unknown): value is File =>
 106| |  typeof File !== "undefined" && value instanceof File;
 108|▼|function formDataToRecord(fd: FormData): Record<string, string> {
 109| |  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
 111| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value, key) => {
 112| |    if (typeof value === "string") {
 113| |      out[key] = value;
 114| |    } else if (isFile(value)) {
 115| |      out[key] = value.name;
 116| |    }
 117| |  });
 119| |  return out;
 120| |}
 122|▼|function formDataToObject(fd: FormData): Record<string, unknown> {
 123| |  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 125| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value, key) => {
 126| |    const existing = out[key];
 128| |    if (existing === undefined) {
 129| |      out[key] = value;
 130| |    } else if (Array.isArray(existing)) {
 131| |      existing.push(value);
 132| |    } else {
 133| |      out[key] = [existing, value];
 134| |    }
 135| |  });
 137| |  return out;
 138| |}
 140|▼|export function createLazyBody(
 141| |  req: Request,
 142| |  opts: LazyBodyOptions = {}
 143| |): LazyBody {
 144| |  const limits = {
 145| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxJsonBytes,
 146| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxTextBytes,
 147| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFormBytes,
 148| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFileBytes,
 149| |  };
 151| |  let kind: BodyKind = "none";
 152| |  let value: unknown;
 154| |  let pending: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
 155| |  let pendingKind: BodyKind | null = null;
 157|▼|  function assertSize(max?: number): void {
 158| |    if (!max) return;
 160| |    const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
 161| |    if (Number.isFinite(len) && len > max) {
 162|!|      throw new BodyParseError("Payload too large", 413);
 163| |    }
 164| |  }
 166|▼|  function convert<T>(target: BodyKind): T {
 167| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 169| |    if (kind === "json") {
 170| |      const text = JSON.stringify(value);
 172| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 173| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 174| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 175| |      }
 176| |      if (target === "blob") {
 177| |        return new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" }) as T;
 178| |      }
 179| |    }
 181| |    if (kind === "text") {
 182| |      const text = value as string;
 184| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 185| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 186| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 187| |      }
 188| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([text]) as T;
 190| |      if (target === "formData") {
 191| |        const fd = new FormData();
 192| |        new URLSearchParams(text).forEach((v, k) => fd.append(k, v));
 193| |        return fd as T;
 194| |      }
 195| |    }
 197| |    if (kind === "arrayBuffer") {
 198| |      const buf = value as ArrayBuffer;
 199| |      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(buf);
 201| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 202| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 203| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([buf]) as T;
 204| |    }
 206| |    if (kind === "formData") {
 207| |      const fd = value as FormData;
 209| |      if (target === "text") {
 210| |        const params = new URLSearchParams();
 212| |        forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (v, k) => {
 213| |          if (typeof v === "string") {
 214| |            params.append(k, v);
 215| |          }
 216| |        });
 218| |        return params.toString() as T;
 219| |      }
 220| |    }
 222|!|    throw new BodyParseError(
 223| |      `Body already consumed as "${kind}"; cannot parse as "${target}".`,
 224| |      409
 225| |    );
 226| |  }
 228|▼|  async function use<T>(
 229| |    target: BodyKind,
 230| |    parser: () => Promise<T>,
 231| |    max?: number
 232| |  ): Promise<T> {
 233| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 234| |    if (kind !== "none") return convert<T>(target);
 236| |    if (pending) {
 237| |      if (pendingKind === target) return pending as Promise<T>;
 239|!|      throw new BodyParseError(
 240| |        `Body parse already in progress as "${pendingKind}".`,
 241| |        409
 242| |      );
 243| |    }
 245| |    assertSize(max);
 247| |    pendingKind = target;
 249| |    pending = parser()
 250| |      .then((v) => {
 251| |        kind = target;
 252| |        value = v;
 253| |        pending = null;
 254| |        pendingKind = null;
 255| |        return v;
 256| |      })
 257| |      .catch((err) => {
 258| |        pending = null;
 259| |        pendingKind = null;
 260|!|        throw err;
 261| |      });
 263| |    return pending as Promise<T>;
 264| |  }
 266|▼|  function assertFileSize(file: File): void {
 267| |    if (limits.maxFileBytes && file.size > limits.maxFileBytes) {
 268|!|      throw new BodyParseError("File too large", 413);
 269| |    }
 270| |  }
 272|▼|  const fn = async (): Promise<unknown> => {
 273| |    if (req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD" || req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 274| |      return undefined;
 275| |    }
 277| |    const ct = (req.headers.get("content-type") || "")
 278| |      .split(";")[0]
 279| |      ?.trim()
 280| |      .toLowerCase();
 282| |    if (!ct) return undefined;
 284| |    const self = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 286| |    if (ct.includes("json")) return self.json();
 287| |    if (ct.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) return self.form();
 288| |    if (ct.includes("multipart/form-data")) return self.multipart();
 289| |    if (ct.startsWith("text/")) return self.text();
 291| |    return self.arrayBuffer();
 292| |  };
 294| |  const body = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 296| |  body.json = <T = unknown>() =>
 297| |    use<T>(
 298| |      "json",
 299| |      async () => {
 300| |        try {
 301| |          return (await req.json()) as T;
 302| |        } catch {
 303|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid JSON body", 400);
 304| |        }
 305| |      },
 306| |      limits.maxJsonBytes,
 307| |    );
 309| |  body.text = () =>
 310| |    use<string>(
 311| |      "text",
 312| |      async () => {
 313| |        try {
 314| |          return await req.text();
 315| |        } catch {
 316|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid text body", 400);
 317| |        }
 318| |      },
 319| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 320| |    );
 322| |  body.arrayBuffer = () =>
 323| |    use<ArrayBuffer>(
 324| |      "arrayBuffer",
 325| |      async () => {
 326| |        try {
 327| |          return await req.arrayBuffer();
 328| |        } catch {
 329|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid binary body", 400);
 330| |        }
 331| |      },
 332| |      limits.maxFileBytes
 333| |    );
 335| |  body.blob = () =>
 336| |    use<Blob>(
 337| |      "blob",
 338| |      async () => {
 339| |        try {
 340| |          return await req.blob();
 341| |        } catch {
 342|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid blob body", 400);
 343| |        }
 344| |      },
 345| |      limits.maxFileBytes
 346| |    );
 348| |  body.formData = () =>
 349| |    use<FormData>(
 350| |      "formData",
 351| |      async () => {
 352| |        try {
 353| |          return (await req.formData()) as unknown as FormData;
 354| |        } catch {
 355|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid form/multipart body", 400);
 356| |        }
 357| |      },
 358| |      limits.maxFormBytes,
 359| |    );
 361| |  body.form = async () => {
 362| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 363| |    return formDataToRecord(fd);
 364| |  };
 366| |  body.multipart = async () => {
 367| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 368| |    return formDataToObject(fd);
 369| |  };
 371| |body.file = async (name?: string) => {
 372| |  const fd = await body.formData();
 374| |  if (name) {
 375| |    const value = getFormDataEntry(fd, name);
 377| |    if (isFile(value)) {
 378| |      assertFileSize(value);
 379| |      return value;
 380| |    }
 382| |    return null;
 383| |  }
 385| |  let found: File | null = null;
 387| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value) => {
 388| |    if (!found && isFile(value)) {
 389| |      assertFileSize(value);
 390| |      found = value;
 391| |    }
 392| |  });
 394| |  return found;
 395| |};
 397| |body.files = async (name?: string) => {
 398| |  const fd = await body.formData();
 399| |  const files: File[] = [];
 401| |  if (name) {
 402| |    for (const value of getAllFormDataEntries(fd, name)) {
 403| |      if (isFile(value)) {
 404| |        assertFileSize(value);
 405| |        files.push(value);
 406| |      }
 407| |    }
 409| |    return files;
 410| |  }
 412| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value) => {
 413| |    if (isFile(value)) {
 414| |      assertFileSize(value);
 415| |      files.push(value);
 416| |    }
 417| |  });
 419| |  return files;
 420| |};
 422| |  body.stream = () => {
 423| |    if (kind !== "none") return null;
 424| |    return req.body;
 425| |  };
 427| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "consumed", {
 428| |    get: () => kind !== "none",
 429| |  });
 431| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "parsed", {
 432| |    get: () => value,
 433| |  });
 435| |  return body;
 436| |}
 438| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 439| |// Backward compatibility helpers
 440| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 442|▼|export interface BodyParser {
 443| |  readonly contentTypes: readonly string[];
 444| |  parse(req: Request): Promise<unknown>;
 445| |}
 447| |export const jsonParser: BodyParser = {
 448| |  contentTypes: ["application/json"],
 449| |  async parse(req) {
 450| |    return createLazyBody(req).json();
 451| |  },
 452| |};
 454| |export const formUrlEncodedParser: BodyParser = {
 455| |  contentTypes: ["application/x-www-form-urlencoded"],
 456| |  async parse(req) {
 457| |    return createLazyBody(req).form();
 458| |  },
 459| |};
 461| |export const multipartParser: BodyParser = {
 462| |  contentTypes: ["multipart/form-data"],
 463| |  async parse(req) {
 464| |    return createLazyBody(req).multipart();
 465| |  },
 466| |};
 468| |export const defaultParsers: readonly BodyParser[] = [
 469| |  jsonParser,
 470| |  formUrlEncodedParser,
 471| |  multipartParser,
 472| |];
 474|▼|export async function parseBody(
 475| |  req: Request,
 476| |  _parsers: readonly BodyParser[] = defaultParsers
 477| |): Promise<unknown> {
 478| |  return createLazyBody(req)();
 479| |}
 481|▼|export function needsBodyParse(method: string): boolean {
 482| |  return method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD" && method !== "OPTIONS";
 483| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * Multi-core server helper.
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - uses node:os availableParallelism()
   6| | * - avoids extending a union type
   7| | * - satisfies exactOptionalPropertyTypes
   8| | */
  10| |import { availableParallelism } from "node:os";
  12|▼|export type ServeOptions = Parameters<typeof Bun.serve>[0];
  14|▼|export type ClusterServeOptions = ServeOptions & {
  15| |  workers?: number | "auto";
  16| |};
  18|▼|export function serveCluster(options: ClusterServeOptions) {
  19| |  const requested = options.workers ?? 1;
  21| |  const count =
  22| |    requested === "auto"
  23| |      ? Math.max(1, availableParallelism())
  24| |      : Math.max(1, Number(requested));
  26| |  const serveOptions: Record<string, unknown> = { ...options };
  28| |  delete serveOptions.workers;
  30| |  if (count > 1) {
  31| |    serveOptions.reusePort = true;
  32| |  }
  34| |  const servers = Array.from({ length: count }, () =>
  35| |    Bun.serve(serveOptions as unknown as ServeOptions),
  36| |  );
  38| |  return {
  39| |    servers,
  40| |    port: servers[0]?.port,
  41| |    stop() {
  42| |      for (const server of servers) {
  43| |        server.stop();
  44| |      }
  45| |    },
  46| |  };
  47| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Error Types v3.0
   3| | * Serializable, traceable, production-safe.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export class HTTPError extends Error {
   7| |  constructor(
   8| |    public readonly status: number,
   9| |    message: string,
  10| |    public readonly code?: string,
  11| |    public readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>
  12| |  ) {
  13| |    super(message);
  14| |    this.name = "HTTPError";
  15| |  }
  17| |  toJSON() {
  18| |    return {
  19| |      error: this.message,
  20| |      status: this.status,
  21| |      code: this.code,
  22| |      ...(this.details ? { details: this.details } : {}),
  23| |    };
  24| |  }
  26| |  toResponse(headers?: Record<string, string>): Response {
  27| |    return Response.json(this.toJSON(), {
  28| |      status: this.status,
  29| |      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...headers },
  30| |    });
  31| |  }
  32| |}
  34|▼|export class ValidationError extends HTTPError {
  35| |  constructor(
  36| |    message: string,
  37| |    public readonly errors: Record<string, string[]>,
  38| |    public readonly on?: string
  39| |  ) {
  40| |    super(422, message, "VALIDATION_ERROR", { errors, on });
  41| |    this.name = "ValidationError";
  42| |  }
  43| |}
  45|▼|export class NotFoundError extends HTTPError {
  46| |  constructor(resource?: string) {
  47| |    super(404, resource ? `${resource} not found` : "Not Found", "NOT_FOUND");
  48| |    this.name = "NotFoundError";
  49| |  }
  50| |}
  52|▼|export class UnauthorizedError extends HTTPError {
  53| |  constructor(message = "Unauthorized") {
  54| |    super(401, message, "UNAUTHORIZED");
  55| |    this.name = "UnauthorizedError";
  56| |  }
  57| |}
  59|▼|export class ForbiddenError extends HTTPError {
  60| |  constructor(message = "Forbidden") {
  61| |    super(403, message, "FORBIDDEN");
  62| |    this.name = "ForbiddenError";
  63| |  }
  64| |}
  66|▼|export class ConflictError extends HTTPError {
  67| |  constructor(message = "Conflict") {
  68| |    super(409, message, "CONFLICT");
  69| |    this.name = "ConflictError";
  70| |  }
  71| |}
  73|▼|export class TooManyRequestsError extends HTTPError {
  74| |  constructor(message = "Too Many Requests", public readonly retryAfter?: number) {
  75| |    super(429, message, "TOO_MANY_REQUESTS");
  76| |    this.name = "TooManyRequestsError";
  77| |  }
  78| |}
  80|▼|export class InternalError extends HTTPError {

  82| |    super(500, message, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  83| |    this.name = "InternalError";
  84| |  }
  85| |}
  87|▼|export class ParseError extends HTTPError {

  90| |    this.name = "ParseError";

  92| |  }
  93| |}
  95|▼|export class InvalidCookieSignature extends HTTPError {
  96| |  constructor(public readonly key: string) {

  98| |    this.name = "InvalidCookieSignature";
  99| |  }
 100| |}
 102| |// ============================================================================
 103| |// Error → Response Mapping
 104| |// ============================================================================
 106|▼|export const errorToResponse = (err: unknown, exposeDetails = false): Response => {
 107| |  if (err instanceof HTTPError) return err.toResponse();
 109| |  const message = exposeDetails && err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal Server Error";
 110| |  return Response.json(
 111| |    { error: message, status: 500, code: "INTERNAL_ERROR" },
 112| |    { status: 500 }
 113| |  );
 114| |};
 116| |// ============================================================================
 117| |// Status Map (Type-safe status codes)
 118| |// ============================================================================
 120| |export const StatusMap = {
 121| |  Continue: 100, "Switching Protocols": 101, Processing: 102,
 122| |  OK: 200, Created: 201, Accepted: 202, "No Content": 204, "Partial Content": 206,
 123| |  "Multiple Choices": 300, "Moved Permanently": 301, Found: 302, "Not Modified": 304,
 124| |  "Bad Request": 400, Unauthorized: 401, Forbidden: 403, "Not Found": 404,
 125| |  "Method Not Allowed": 405, Conflict: 409, Gone: 410, "Too Many Requests": 429,
 126| |  "Internal Server Error": 500, "Bad Gateway": 502, "Service Unavailable": 503,
 127| |} as const;

>src/core/lru.ts
i:lru-cache
e:LRUCacheOptions|LRUCache
f:createEntry(
  value: V,
  bytes: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  staleTtlMs: number,
  now: number,
):Entry<V>
c:LRUCache
t:LRUCacheOptions
t:Entry
t:WriteOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Production LRU cache backed by lru-cache.
   3| | *
   4| | * Design:
   5| | * - Strict key constraint
   6| | * - Pure entry factory
   7| | * - No explicit undefined option properties
   8| | * - Single-flight getOrSet
   9| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache as LRU } from "lru-cache";
  12|▼|export interface LRUCacheOptions<K extends {}, V> {
  13| |  max?: number;
  14| |  ttlMs?: number;
  15| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  16| |  maxBytes?: number;
  17| |  sizeOf?: (value: V, key: K) => number;
  18| |  onEvict?: (key: K, value: V) => void;
  19| |}
  21|▼|interface Entry<V> {
  22| |  value: V;
  23| |  bytes: number;
  24| |  expiresAt: number;
  25| |  staleAt: number;
  26| |}
  28|▼|interface WriteOptions {
  29| |  ttlMs?: number;
  30| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  31| |  bytes?: number;
  32| |}
  34| |/**
  35| | * Create a cache entry with resolved expiry metadata.
  36| | */
  37|▼|const createEntry = <V>(
  38| |  value: V,
  39| |  bytes: number,
  40| |  ttlMs: number,
  41| |  staleTtlMs: number,
  42| |  now: number,
  43| |): Entry<V> => {
  44| |  const expiresAt = ttlMs > 0 ? now + ttlMs : 0;
  45| |  const staleAt = staleTtlMs > 0 ? now + staleTtlMs : expiresAt;
  47| |  return {
  48| |    value,
  49| |    bytes,
  50| |    expiresAt,
  51| |    staleAt,
  52| |  };
  53| |};
  55|▼|export class LRUCache<K extends {}, V> {
  56| |  private lru: LRU<K, Entry<V>>;
  57| |  private inflight = new Map<K, Promise<V>>();
  59| |  constructor(private readonly opts: LRUCacheOptions<K, V> = {}) {
  60| |    this.lru = new LRU<K, Entry<V>>({
  61| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
  62| |      sizeCalculation: (entry) => Math.max(1, entry.bytes),
  63| |      dispose: (entry, key) => {
  64| |        opts.onEvict?.(key, entry.value);
  65| |      },
  66| |      ...(opts.maxBytes !== undefined ? { maxSize: opts.maxBytes } : {}),
  67| |    });
  68| |  }
  70| |  get size(): number {
  71| |    return this.lru.size;
  72| |  }
  74| |  get byteSize(): number {
  75| |    return this.lru.calculatedSize;
  76| |  }
  78| |  private now(): number {
  79| |    return Date.now();
  80| |  }
  82| |  private alive(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  83| |    return entry.expiresAt === 0 || entry.expiresAt > now;
  84| |  }
  86| |  private fresh(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  87| |    return entry.staleAt === 0 || entry.staleAt > now;
  88| |  }
  90| |  get(key: K, options: { allowStale?: boolean } = {}): V | undefined {
  91| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
  92| |    if (!entry) return undefined;
  94| |    const now = this.now();
  96| |    if (!this.alive(entry, now)) {
  97| |      this.lru.delete(key);
  98| |      return undefined;
  99| |    }
 101| |    if (!options.allowStale && !this.fresh(entry, now)) {
 102| |      return undefined;
 103| |    }
 105| |    return entry.value;
 106| |  }
 108| |  set(key: K, value: V, options: WriteOptions = {}): this {
 109| |    const ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? this.opts.ttlMs ?? 0;
 110| |    const staleTtlMs = options.staleTtlMs ?? this.opts.staleTtlMs ?? 0;
 111| |    const bytes = options.bytes ?? this.opts.sizeOf?.(value, key) ?? 0;
 113| |    const maxBytes = this.opts.maxBytes ?? 0;
 114| |    if (maxBytes > 0 && bytes > maxBytes) return this;
 116| |    const entry = createEntry(value, bytes, ttlMs, staleTtlMs, this.now());
 117| |    const lruTtl = Math.max(ttlMs, staleTtlMs);
 119| |    if (lruTtl > 0) {
 120| |      this.lru.set(key, entry, { ttl: lruTtl });
 121| |    } else {
 122| |      this.lru.set(key, entry);
 123| |    }
 125| |    return this;
 126| |  }
 128| |  delete(key: K): boolean {
 129| |    return this.lru.delete(key);
 130| |  }
 132| |  clear(): void {
 133| |    this.lru.clear();
 134| |    this.inflight.clear();
 135| |  }
 137| |  async getOrSet(
 138| |    key: K,
 139| |    factory: () => Promise<V> | V,
 140| |    options: WriteOptions = {},
 141| |  ): Promise<V> {
 142| |    const now = this.now();
 143| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
 145| |    if (entry && this.alive(entry, now)) {
 146| |      if (!this.fresh(entry, now) && !this.inflight.has(key)) {
 147| |        const revalidate = Promise.resolve()
 148| |          .then(factory)
 149| |          .then((value) => {
 150| |            this.set(key, value, options);
 151| |            return value;
 152| |          })
 153| |          .catch(() => entry.value)
 154| |          .finally(() => {
 155| |            this.inflight.delete(key);
 156| |          });
 158| |        this.inflight.set(key, revalidate);
 159| |      }
 161| |      return entry.value;
 162| |    }
 164| |    const pending = this.inflight.get(key);
 165| |    if (pending) return pending;
 167| |    const promise = Promise.resolve()
 168| |      .then(factory)
 169| |      .then((value) => {
 170| |        this.set(key, value, options);
 171| |        return value;
 172| |      })
 173| |      .finally(() => {
 174| |        this.inflight.delete(key);
 175| |      });
 177| |    this.inflight.set(key, promise);
 178| |    return promise;
 179| |  }
 180| |}
---

):ProxyRequestInit
f:isTimeoutError(err: unknown):boolean
f:createGatewayTimeout():Response
f:createBadGateway():Response
t:FetchRequestInit
t:ProxyRequestInit
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Proxy / forwarding helpers.
   3| | *
   4| | * Design:
   5| | * - Pure header sanitizers
   6| | * - Pure request-init factory
   7| | * - No global BodyInit dependency
   8| | * - AbortSignal.timeout based cancellation
   9| | */
  11| |const HOP_BY_HOP = [
  12| |  "connection",
  13| |  "keep-alive",
  14| |  "proxy-authenticate",
  15| |  "proxy-authorization",
  16| |  "te",
  17| |  "trailer",
  18| |  "transfer-encoding",
  19| |  "upgrade",
  20| |] as const;
  22|▼|type FetchRequestInit = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof fetch>[1]>;
  24|▼|type ProxyRequestInit = FetchRequestInit & {
  25| |  duplex?: "half";
  26| |};
  28| |export interface ProxyOptions extends Omit<FetchRequestInit, "body"> {
  29| |  timeoutMs?: number;
  30| |  body?: FetchRequestInit["body"];
  31| |}
  33| |/**
  34| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers and request-specific headers
  35| | * that must be recomputed for upstream.
  36| | */
  37|▼|const sanitizeRequestHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  38| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  40| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  42| |  out.delete("host");
  43| |  out.delete("content-length");
  45| |  return out;
  46| |};
  48| |/**
  49| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers from upstream response.
  50| | */
  51|▼|const sanitizeResponseHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  52| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  54| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  56| |  return out;
  57| |};
  59| |/**
  60| | * Create a combined timeout + optional caller signal.
  61| | */
  62|▼|const createProxySignal = (opts: ProxyOptions): AbortSignal => {
  63| |  const timeoutSignal = AbortSignal.timeout(opts.timeoutMs ?? 10_000);
  65| |  if (!opts.signal) return timeoutSignal;
  67| |  if (typeof AbortSignal.any === "function") {
  68| |    return AbortSignal.any([opts.signal, timeoutSignal]);
  69| |  }
  71| |  return timeoutSignal;
  72| |};
  74| |/**
  75| | * Type guard for stream-like bodies.
  76| | */
  77|▼|const isReadableStream = (
  78| |  value: unknown,
  79| |): value is ReadableStream<Uint8Array> =>
  80| |  typeof value === "object" &&
  81| |  value !== null &&
  82| |  "pipeTo" in value &&
  83| |  typeof value.pipeTo === "function";
  85| |/**
  86| | * Build fetch init for upstream request.
  87| | */
  88|▼|const createProxyInit = (
  89| |  opts: ProxyOptions,
  90| |  signal: AbortSignal,
  91| |): ProxyRequestInit => {
  92| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(
  93| |    opts.headers instanceof Headers ? opts.headers : new Headers(opts.headers),
  94| |  );
  96| |  const init: ProxyRequestInit = {
  97| |    method: opts.method ?? "GET",
  98| |    headers,
  99| |    redirect: opts.redirect ?? "manual",
 100| |    signal,
 101| |  };
 103| |  const body = opts.body;
 105| |  if (body != null) {
 106| |    init.body = body;
 108| |    if (isReadableStream(body)) {
 109| |      init.duplex = "half";
 110| |    }
 111| |  }
 113| |  return init;
 114| |};
 116|▼|const isTimeoutError = (err: unknown): boolean =>
 117| |  err instanceof Error &&
 118| |  (err.name === "TimeoutError" || err.name === "AbortError");
 120|▼|const createGatewayTimeout = (): Response =>
 121| |  Response.json({ error: "Upstream timeout", status: 504 }, { status: 504 });
 123|▼|const createBadGateway = (): Response =>
 124| |  Response.json({ error: "Bad Gateway", status: 502 }, { status: 502 });
 126|▼|export async function proxyRequest(
 127| |  target: string | URL,
 128| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 129| |): Promise<Response> {
 130| |  try {
 131| |    const signal = createProxySignal(opts);
 132| |    const init = createProxyInit(opts, signal);
 134| |    const upstream = await fetch(target.toString(), init);
 136| |    const responseHeaders = sanitizeResponseHeaders(upstream.headers);
 137| |    responseHeaders.set("x-proxy", "flux");
 139| |    return new Response(upstream.body, {
 140| |      status: upstream.status,
 141| |      statusText: upstream.statusText,
 142| |      headers: responseHeaders,
 143| |    });
 144|!|  } catch (err) {
 145| |    if (isTimeoutError(err)) {
 146| |      return createGatewayTimeout();
 147| |    }
 149| |    return createBadGateway();
 150| |  }
 151| |}
 153|▼|export async function forwardRequest(
 154| |  req: Request,
 155| |  target: string | URL,
 156| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 157| |): Promise<Response> {
 158| |  const incoming = new URL(req.url);
 159| |  const targetUrl = new URL(target.toString());
 161| |  if (!targetUrl.search) {
 162| |    targetUrl.search = incoming.search;
 163| |  }
 165| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(req.headers);
 167| |  const hasBody =
 168| |    req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD" && req.body != null;
 170| |  const body = hasBody ? req.body : undefined;
 172| |  return proxyRequest(targetUrl, {
 173| |    ...opts,
 174| |    method: req.method,
 175| |    headers,
 176| |    ...(body ? { body } : {}),
 177| |  });
 178| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Server-Sent Events (SSE) support.
   3| | * Streaming responses with proper formatting.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export interface SSEOptions {
   7| |  event?: string;
   8| |  id?: string;
   9| |  retry?: number;
  10| |}
  12|▼|export interface SSEMessage {
  13| |  data: string;
  14| |  event?: string;
  15| |  id?: string;
  16| |  retry?: number;
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const formatSSE = (msg: SSEMessage): string => {
  20| |  let out = "";
  21| |  if (msg.id) out += `id: ${msg.id}\n`;
  22| |  if (msg.event) out += `event: ${msg.event}\n`;
  23| |  if (msg.retry) out += `retry: ${msg.retry}\n`;
  24| |  out += `data: ${msg.data}\n\n`;
  25| |  return out;
  26| |};
  28|▼|export const sse = (
  29| |  generator: AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage> | Generator<string | SSEMessage>,
  30| |  init?: ResponseInit
  31| |): Response => {
  32| |  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  34| |  const stream = new ReadableStream({
  35| |    async start(controller) {
  36| |      try {
  37| |        for await (const chunk of generator as AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage>) {
  38| |          const msg = typeof chunk === "string" ? { data: chunk } : chunk;
  39| |          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(formatSSE(msg)));
  40| |        }
  41| |      } catch { /* stream closed */ }
  42| |      finally { controller.close(); }
  43| |    }
  44| |  });
  46| |  return new Response(stream, {
  47| |    ...init,
  48| |    headers: {
  49| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  50| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  51| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  52| |      ...init?.headers,
  53| |    },
  54| |  });
  55| |};
  57|▼|export const sseFromStream = (stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response =>
  58| |  new Response(stream, {
  59| |    ...init,
  60| |    headers: {
  61| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  62| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  63| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  64| |      ...init?.headers,
  65| |    },
  66| |  });

>src/core/trace.ts
e:TraceEvent|TraceSpan|TraceContext|createTraceContext|startTrace|finishTrace

  _req: Request,

t:TraceContext
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Distributed tracing helpers.
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - uses crypto.randomUUID()
   6| | * - does not mutate response headers directly
   7| | */
   9|▼|export type TraceEvent =
  10| |  | "request"
  11| |  | "parse"
  12| |  | "transform"
  13| |  | "beforeHandle"
  14| |  | "handle"
  15| |  | "afterHandle"
  16| |  | "mapResponse"
  17| |  | "afterResponse"
  18| |  | "error";
  20|▼|export interface TraceSpan {
  21| |  id: string;
  22| |  name: string;
  23| |  event: TraceEvent;
  24| |  begin: number;
  25| |  end?: number;
  26| |  error?: Error | null;
  27| |  attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
  28| |  children: TraceSpan[];
  29| |}
  31|▼|export interface TraceContext {
  32| |  traceId: string;
  33| |  spans: TraceSpan[];
  34| |  startSpan(name: string, event: TraceEvent): TraceSpan;
  35| |  endSpan(span: TraceSpan, error?: Error | null): void;
  36| |}
  38| |let traceCounter = 0;
  40|▼|export const createTraceContext = (requestId: string): TraceContext => {
  41| |  const spans: TraceSpan[] = [];
  43| |  return {
  44| |    traceId: requestId,
  45| |    spans,
  46| |    startSpan(name, event) {
  47| |      const span: TraceSpan = {
  48| |        id: `${requestId}-${++traceCounter}`,
  49| |        name,
  50| |        event,
  51| |        begin: performance.now(),
  52| |        children: [],
  53| |      };
  55| |      spans.push(span);
  56| |      return span;
  57| |    },
  58| |    endSpan(span, error = null) {
  59| |      span.end = performance.now();
  60| |      span.error = error;
  61| |    },
  62| |  };
  63| |};
  65| |export const startTrace = (req: Request): { traceId: string; start: number } => {
  66| |  const traceId =
  67| |    req.headers.get("x-trace-id") ||
  68| |    req.headers.get("x-request-id") ||
  69| |    crypto.randomUUID();
  71| |  return { traceId, start: performance.now() };
  72| |};
  74|▼|export const finishTrace = (
  75| |  _req: Request,
  76| |  trace: { traceId: string; start: number },
  77| |  response: Response
  78| |): Response => {
  79| |  const duration = performance.now() - trace.start;
  81| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  82| |  headers.set("x-trace-id", trace.traceId);
  83| |  headers.set("x-response-time", duration.toFixed(2) + "ms");
  85| |  return new Response(response.body, {
  86| |    status: response.status,
  87| |    statusText: response.statusText,
  88| |    headers,
  89| |  });
  90| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview HTTP caching primitives:
   3| | * - Cache-Control builder
   4| | * - ETag generation
   5| | * - mtime-based cache bursting
   6| | * - browser conditional requests
   7| | * - LRU-backed HTTP response cache
   8| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache } from "./lru";
  12|▼|export interface CacheControlOptions {
  13| |  maxAge?: number;
  14| |  sMaxAge?: number;
  15| |  swr?: number; // stale-while-revalidate seconds
  16| |  immutable?: boolean;
  17| |  noStore?: boolean;
  18| |  noCache?: boolean;
  19| |  public?: boolean;
  20| |  private?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |export interface BrowserCacheOptions extends CacheControlOptions {
  24| |  req?: Request;
  25| |  etag?: string;
  26| |  lastModified?: Date | string;
  27| |  vary?: string[];
  28| |}
  30|▼|export function cacheControl(opts: CacheControlOptions = {}): string {
  31| |  if (opts.noStore) return "no-store";
  32| |  if (opts.noCache) return "no-cache";
  34| |  const parts: string[] = [];
  36| |  if (opts.public) parts.push("public");
  37| |  if (opts.private) parts.push("private");
  39| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
  40| |    parts.push(`max-age=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.maxAge))}`);
  41| |  }
  43| |  if (opts.swr != null) {
  44| |    parts.push(`stale-while-revalidate=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.swr))}`);
  45| |  }
  47| |  if (opts.sMaxAge != null) {
  48| |    parts.push(`s-maxage=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.sMaxAge))}`);
  49| |  }
  51| |  if (opts.immutable) parts.push("immutable");
  53| |  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : "no-cache";
  54| |}
  56|▼|function toBytes(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  57| |  if (typeof input === "string") return new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  58| |  if (input instanceof Uint8Array) return input;
  59| |  return new Uint8Array(input);
  60| |}
  62|▼|function fallbackHash(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
  63| |  let h = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
  65| |  for (const b of bytes) {
  66| |    h ^= BigInt(b);
  67| |    h = (h * 0x100000001b3n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  68| |  }
  70| |  return h;
  71| |}
  73| |/**
  74| | * Fast non-cryptographic hash for cache keys and weak ETags.
  75| | * Uses Bun.hash when available.
  76| | */
  77|▼|export function fastHash(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): string {
  78| |  const bytes = toBytes(input);
  80| |  const bunHash = (Bun as any).hash;
  81| |  if (typeof bunHash === "function") {
  82| |    const h = bunHash(bytes);
  83| |    return (typeof h === "bigint" ? h : BigInt(h)).toString(36);
  84| |  }
  86| |  return fallbackHash(bytes).toString(36);
  87| |}
  89|▼|export function entityTag(
  90| |  body: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  91| |  weak = true
  92| |): string {
  93| |  return `${weak ? "W/" : ""}"${fastHash(body)}"`;
  94| |}
  96| |/**
  97| | * mtime-based cache burst version.
  98| | *
  99| | * Example:
 100| | *   mtimeVersion(stats.mtimeMs, stats.size)
 101| | *   => "m4k2j1-1a2b"
 102| | */
 103|▼|export function mtimeVersion(mtimeMs: number, size?: number): string {
 104| |  const mtime = Math.floor(mtimeMs).toString(36);
 105| |  return size ? `${mtime}-${size.toString(36)}` : mtime;
 106| |}
 108| |/**
 109| | * Append a cache-busting version to a URL.
 110| | */
 111|▼|export function withCacheBurst(url: string, version: string): string {
 112| |  const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
 113| |  return `${url}${sep}v=${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
 114| |}
 116| |/**
 117| | * Apply browser cache headers and handle conditional requests.
 118| | */
 119|▼|export function withBrowserCache(
 120| |  response: Response,
 121| |  opts: BrowserCacheOptions = {}
 122| |): Response {
 123| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 125| |  if (opts.etag) headers.set("etag", opts.etag);
 127| |  const lastModified =
 128| |    opts.lastModified instanceof Date
 129| |      ? opts.lastModified.toUTCString()
 130| |      : opts.lastModified;
 132| |  if (lastModified) headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 134| |  if (!headers.has("cache-control")) {
 135| |    headers.set("cache-control", cacheControl(opts));
 136| |  }
 138| |  if (opts.vary?.length) {
 139| |    headers.set("vary", opts.vary.join(", "));
 140| |  }
 142| |  if (opts.req && response.status !== 304) {
 143| |    const inm = opts.req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 144| |    const ims = opts.req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
 146| |    const etagMatch =
 147| |      opts.etag && inm
 148| |        ? inm
 149| |            .split(",")
 150| |            .map((s) => s.trim())
 151| |            .includes(opts.etag)
 152| |        : false;
 154| |    const lastModifiedMatch =
 155| |      lastModified && ims
 156| |        ? new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()
 157| |        : false;
 159| |    if (etagMatch || lastModifiedMatch) {
 160| |      return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers });
 161| |    }
 162| |  }
 164| |  return new Response(response.body, {
 165| |    status: response.status,
 166| |    statusText: response.statusText,
 167| |    headers,
 168| |  });
 169| |}
 171| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172| |// HTTP response cache
 173| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175|▼|export interface HttpResponseCacheOptions {
 176| |  max?: number;
 177| |  ttlMs?: number;
 178| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
 179| |  maxBytes?: number;
 180| |  maxBodyBytes?: number;
 181| |}
 183|▼|export interface CachedHttpResponse {
 184| |  status: number;
 185| |  statusText: string;
 186| |  headers: [string, string][];
 187| |  body: ArrayBuffer | null;
 188| |  etag?: string;
 189| |}
 191| |const HOP_HEADERS = new Set([
 192| |  "connection",
 193| |  "keep-alive",
 194| |  "proxy-authenticate",
 195| |  "proxy-authorization",
 196| |  "te",
 197| |  "trailer",
 198| |  "transfer-encoding",
 199| |  "upgrade",
 200| |  "content-length",
 201| |]);
 203|▼|function sanitizeHeaders(headers: Headers): [string, string][] {
 204| |  const out: [string, string][] = [];
 206| |  headers.forEach((value, key) => {
 207| |    const lower = key.toLowerCase();
 208| |    if (!HOP_HEADERS.has(lower)) {
 209| |      out.push([key, value]);
 210| |    }
 211| |  });
 213| |  return out;
 214| |}
 216|▼|function isCacheableResponse(response: Response): boolean {
 217| |  if (response.headers.has("set-cookie")) return false;
 219| |  const cc = response.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 220| |  if (cc.includes("no-store")) return false;
 221| |  if (cc.includes("private")) return false;
 223| |  return [200, 203, 204, 300, 301, 404, 410].includes(response.status);
 224| |}
 226|▼|export class HttpResponseCache {
 227| |  private lru: LRUCache<string, CachedHttpResponse>;
 228| |  private maxBodyBytes: number;
 230| |  constructor(opts: HttpResponseCacheOptions = {}) {
 231| |    this.maxBodyBytes = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_048_576;
 233| |    this.lru = new LRUCache({
 234| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
 235| |      ttlMs: opts.ttlMs ?? 60_000,
 236| |      staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs ?? 300_000,
 237| |      maxBytes: opts.maxBytes ?? 64 * 1024 * 1024,
 238| |      sizeOf: (v) => (v.body?.byteLength ?? 0) + 512,
 239| |    });
 240| |  }
 242| |  key(req: Request, vary: string[] = []): string {
 243| |    const url = new URL(req.url);
 245| |    const varyKey = vary
 246| |      .map((h) => `${h.toLowerCase()}=${req.headers.get(h) ?? ""}`)
 247| |      .join("|");
 249| |    return `${req.method}:${url.pathname}${url.search}:${varyKey}`;
 250| |  }
 252| |  async get(req: Request, key: string): Promise<Response | null> {
 253| |    const stored = this.lru.get(key, { allowStale: true });
 254| |    if (!stored) return null;
 256| |    const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 258| |    if (
 259| |      stored.etag &&
 260| |      inm &&
 261| |      inm
 262| |        .split(",")
 263| |        .map((s) => s.trim())
 264| |        .includes(stored.etag)
 265| |    ) {
 266| |      return new Response(null, {
 267| |        status: 304,
 268| |        headers: stored.headers,
 269| |      });
 270| |    }
 272| |    const headers = new Headers(stored.headers);
 273| |    headers.set("x-cache", "hit");
 275| |    return new Response(stored.body ? stored.body.slice(0) : null, {
 276| |      status: stored.status,
 277| |      statusText: stored.statusText,
 278| |      headers,
 279| |    });
 280| |  }
 282| |  async set(
 283| |    key: string,
 284| |    response: Response,
 285| |    opts: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; etag?: boolean } = {},
 286| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 287| |    if (!isCacheableResponse(response)) return response;
 289| |    const clone = response.clone();
 290| |    const body = await clone.arrayBuffer();
 292| |    if (body.byteLength > this.maxBodyBytes) {
 293| |      return response;
 294| |    }
 296| |    const headers = sanitizeHeaders(response.headers);
 297| |    const etag = opts.etag === false ? undefined : entityTag(body);
 299| |    if (etag) {
 300| |      headers.push(["etag", etag]);
 301| |    }
 303| |    const cached: CachedHttpResponse = {
 304| |      status: response.status,
 305| |      statusText: response.statusText,
 306| |      headers,
 307| |      body,
 308| |    };
 310| |    if (etag) {
 311| |      cached.etag = etag;
 312| |    }
 314| |    this.lru.set(key, cached, {
 315| |      ...(opts.ttlMs !== undefined ? { ttlMs: opts.ttlMs } : {}),
 316| |      ...(opts.staleTtlMs !== undefined ? { staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs } : {}),
 317| |    });
 319| |    return response;
 320| |  }
 322| |  async getOrSet(
 323| |    req: Request,
 324| |    factory: () => Promise<Response>,
 325| |    opts: {
 326| |      ttlMs?: number;
 327| |      staleTtlMs?: number;
 328| |      vary?: string[];
 329| |      etag?: boolean;
 330| |    } = {}
 331| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 332| |    if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
 333| |      return factory();
 334| |    }
 336| |    const reqCc = req.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 337| |    if (reqCc.includes("no-store")) {
 338| |      return factory();
 339| |    }
 341| |    const key = this.key(req, opts.vary);
 342| |    const hit = await this.get(req, key);
 344| |    if (hit) return hit;
 346| |    const response = await factory();
 347| |    return this.set(key, response, opts);
 348| |  }
 349| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview File response helpers:
   3| | * - static file serving
   4| | * - downloads
   5| | * - HTTP range requests
   6| | * - conditional requests
   7| | * - mtime/ETag browser caching
   8| | */
  10| |import { stat } from "fs/promises";
  11| |import { basename, resolve, normalize, sep } from "path";
  12| |import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from "./errors";
  13| |import { cacheControl } from "./cache";
  15|▼|export interface SendFileOptions {
  16| |  req?: Request;
  17| |  download?: boolean | string;
  18| |  contentType?: string;
  19| |  maxAge?: number;
  20| |  swr?: number;
  21| |  immutable?: boolean;
  22| |  isPrivate?: boolean;
  23| |}
  25|▼|export interface StreamDownloadOptions {
  26| |  filename?: string;
  27| |  contentType?: string;
  28| |  cacheControl?: string;
  29| |  size?: number;
  30| |}
  32| |/**
  33| | * Prevent path traversal.
  34| | *
  35| | * Example:
  36| | *   safeJoin("public", ctx.params.path)
  37| | */
  38|▼|export function safeJoin(root: string, target: string): string {
  39| |  const resolvedRoot = resolve(root);
  40| |  const resolved = resolve(resolvedRoot, normalize(target));
  42| |  if (!resolved.startsWith(resolvedRoot + sep)) {
  43|!|    throw new ForbiddenError("Invalid file path");
  44| |  }
  46| |  return resolved;
  47| |}
  49|▼|function isNotModified(
  50| |  req: Request,
  51| |  etag: string,
  52| |  lastModified: string
  53| |): boolean {
  54| |  const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
  56| |  if (
  57| |    inm &&
  58| |    inm
  59| |      .split(",")
  60| |      .map((s) => s.trim())
  61| |      .includes(etag)
  62| |  ) {
  63| |    return true;
  64| |  }
  66| |  const ims = req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
  68| |  if (ims && new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()) {
  69| |    return true;
  70| |  }
  72| |  return false;
  73| |}
  75|▼|export async function sendFile(
  76| |  path: string,
  77| |  opts: SendFileOptions = {}
  78| |): Promise<Response> {
  79| |  const stats = await stat(path).catch(() => null);
  81| |  if (!stats || !stats.isFile()) {
  82|!|    throw new NotFoundError("File");
  83| |  }
  85| |  const file = Bun.file(path);
  87| |  const etag = `W/"${stats.size.toString(16)}-${Math.floor(
  88| |    stats.mtimeMs
  89| |  ).toString(16)}"`;
  91| |  const lastModified = stats.mtime.toUTCString();
  93| |  const headers = new Headers();
  95| |  headers.set(
  96| |    "content-type",
  97| |    opts.contentType || file.type || "application/octet-stream"
  98| |  );
 100| |headers.set(
 101| |  "cache-control",
 102| |  cacheControl({
 103| |    public: !opts.isPrivate,
 104| |    maxAge: opts.maxAge ?? 3600,
 105| |    ...(opts.isPrivate !== undefined ? { private: opts.isPrivate } : {}),
 106| |    ...(opts.swr !== undefined ? { swr: opts.swr } : {}),
 107| |    ...(opts.immutable !== undefined ? { immutable: opts.immutable } : {}),
 108| |  }),
 109| |);
 111| |  headers.set("etag", etag);
 112| |  headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 113| |  headers.set("accept-ranges", "bytes");
 115| |  if (opts.download) {
 116| |    const filename =
 117| |      typeof opts.download === "string"
 118| |        ? opts.download
 119| |        : basename(path);
 121| |    headers.set(
 122| |      "content-disposition",
 123| |      `attachment; filename="${filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 124| |    );
 125| |  }
 127| |  if (opts.req && isNotModified(opts.req, etag, lastModified)) {
 128| |    return new Response(null, {
 129| |      status: 304,
 130| |      headers,
 131| |    });
 132| |  }
 134| |  const range = opts.req?.headers.get("range");
 136| |  if (range) {
 137| |    const match = /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(range);
 139| |    if (!match) {
 140| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 141| |        status: 416,
 142| |        headers: {
 143| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 144| |        },
 145| |      });
 146| |    }
 148| |    let start: number;
 149| |    let end: number;
 151| |    if (match[1] === "" && match[2] !== "") {
 152| |      // Suffix range: bytes=-500
 153| |      const suffix = parseInt(match[2]!, 10);
 154| |      start = Math.max(0, stats.size - suffix);
 155| |      end = stats.size - 1;
 156| |    } else {
 157| |      start = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0;
 158| |      end = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : stats.size - 1;
 159| |    }
 161| |    if (
 162| |      Number.isNaN(start) ||
 163| |      Number.isNaN(end) ||
 164| |      start > end ||
 165| |      start >= stats.size
 166| |    ) {
 167| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 168| |        status: 416,
 169| |        headers: {
 170| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 171| |        },
 172| |      });
 173| |    }
 175| |    end = Math.min(end, stats.size - 1);
 177| |    headers.set("content-range", `bytes ${start}-${end}/${stats.size}`);
 178| |    headers.set("content-length", String(end - start + 1));
 180| |    return new Response(file.slice(start, end + 1), {
 181| |      status: 206,
 182| |      headers,
 183| |    });
 184| |  }
 186| |  headers.set("content-length", String(stats.size));
 188| |  return new Response(file, {
 189| |    status: 200,
 190| |    headers,
 191| |  });
 192| |}
 194|▼|export function streamDownload(
 195| |  stream: ReadableStream,
 196| |  opts: StreamDownloadOptions = {}
 197| |): Response {
 198| |  const headers = new Headers({
 199| |    "content-type": opts.contentType || "application/octet-stream",
 200| |    "cache-control": opts.cacheControl || "no-store",
 201| |  });
 203| |  if (opts.filename) {
 204| |    headers.set(
 205| |      "content-disposition",
 206| |      `attachment; filename="${opts.filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 207| |    );
 208| |  }
 210| |  if (opts.size != null) {
 211| |    headers.set("content-length", String(opts.size));
 212| |  }
 214| |  return new Response(stream, {
 215| |    status: 200,
 216| |    headers,
 217| |  });
 218| |}

  89|▼|export type ValidatedCompilerOptions = Static<typeof CompilerOptionsSchema>;
  91| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  92| |  allErrors: true,
  93| |  strict: false,
  94| |  useDefaults: true,
  95| |  coerceTypes: false,
  96| |});
  98| |const validate = ajv.compile(CompilerOptionsSchema);
 100|▼|export const validateOptions = (
 101| |  input: Partial<CompilerOptions>
 102| |): Result<CompilerOptions, string[]> => {
 103| |  const data = { ...DEFAULT_OPTS, ...input };
 105| |  if (validate(data)) {
 106| |    return ok(data as CompilerOptions);
 107| |  }
 109| |  const errors = (validate.errors ?? []).map((e) => {
 110| |    const path =
 111| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
 112| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
 113| |      "options";
 115| |    return `${path}: ${e.message}`;
 116| |  });
 118| |  return err(errors);
 119| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * AOT artifact generation:
   3| | * - routes.d.ts
   4| | * - openapi.json
   5| | * - client.d.ts
   6| | * - manifest.json
   7| | */
   9| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
  10| |import { join } from "path";
  11| |import type { RouteDef, CompilerOptions } from "../types";
  12| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  14|▼|const tsParamType = (paramNames: readonly string[]): string => {
  15| |  if (paramNames.length === 0) return "Record<string, never>";
  17| |  const lines = paramNames.map((name) => `    ${name}: string;`);
  18| |  return `{
  19| |${lines.join("\n")}
  20| |  }`;
  21| |};
  23|▼|export const generateRouteTypes = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): string => {
  24| |  const lines: string[] = [];
  26| |  lines.push("// Auto-generated by Flux AOT compiler.");
  27| |  lines.push("// Do not edit manually.");
  28| |  lines.push("");
  29| |  lines.push("export interface FluxRoutes {");
  31| |  for (const route of routes) {
  32| |    const method = route.method.toLowerCase();
  34| |    lines.push(`  ${JSON.stringify(route.path)}: {`);
  35| |    lines.push(`    ${method}: {`);
  37| |    if (route.paramNames.length > 0) {
  38| |      lines.push(`      params: ${tsParamType(route.paramNames)};`);
  39| |    }
  41| |    if (route.usage.query) {
  42| |      lines.push("      query: Record<string, string | string[]>;");
  43| |    }
  45| |    if (route.usage.body) {
  46| |      lines.push("      body: unknown;");
  47| |    }
  49| |    lines.push("      response: unknown;");
  51| |    lines.push("    };");
  52| |    lines.push("  };");
  53| |  }
  55| |  lines.push("}");
  56| |  lines.push("");
  58| |  return lines.join("\n");
  59| |};
  61|▼|export const generateClientDts = (): string => {
  62| |  return `// Auto-generated by Flux AOT compiler.
  63| |import type { FluxRoutes } from "./routes";
  65| |export type FluxClient = {
  66| |  [Path in keyof FluxRoutes]: {
  67| |    [Method in keyof FluxRoutes[Path]]: (
  68| |      ...args: FluxRoutes[Path][Method] extends { params: infer P }
  69| |        ? [params: P, init?: RequestInit]
  70| |        : [init?: RequestInit]
  71| |    ) => Promise<Response>;
  72| |  };
  73| |};
  75| |export declare function createClient(baseUrl?: string): FluxClient;
  76| |`;
  77| |};
  79|▼|const toOpenApiPath = (path: string): string =>
  80| |  path.replace(/:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}").replace(/\*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}");
  82|▼|export const generateOpenApi = (
  83| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  84| |  opts: CompilerOptions
  85| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  86| |  const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  88| |  for (const route of routes) {
  89| |    if (route.method === "ALL") continue;
  91| |    const openApiPath = toOpenApiPath(route.path);
  92| |    paths[openApiPath] ??= {};
  94| |    const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
  95| |      operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
  96| |      responses: {
  97| |        "200": {
  98| |          description: "Successful response",
  99| |        },
 100| |      },
 101| |    };
 103| |    const detail = (route.config as any)?.detail;
 104| |    if (detail && typeof detail === "object") {
 105| |      Object.assign(operation, detail);
 106| |    }
 108| |    if (route.paramNames.length > 0) {
 109| |      operation.parameters = route.paramNames.map((name) => ({
 110| |        name,
 111| |        in: "path",
 112| |        required: true,
 113| |        schema: { type: "string" },
 114| |      }));
 115| |    }
 117| |    if (route.usage.body) {
 118| |      operation.requestBody = {
 119| |        content: {
 120| |          "application/json": {
 121| |            schema: { type: "object" },
 122| |          },
 123| |        },
 124| |      };
 125| |    }
 127| |    paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
 128| |  }
 130| |  return {
 131| |    openapi: "3.1.0",
 132| |    info: {
 133| |      title: opts.serviceName ?? "flux",
 134| |      version: "1.0.0",
 135| |    },
 136| |    paths,
 137| |  };
 138| |};
 140|▼|export const generateManifest = (
 141| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 142| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 143| |): Record<string, unknown> => ({
 144| |  generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 145| |  serviceName: opts.serviceName ?? "flux",
 146| |  target: opts.target,
 147| |  routes: routes.map((r) => ({
 148| |    method: r.method,
 149| |    path: r.path,
 150| |    file: r.file,
 151| |    isStatic: r.isStatic,
 152| |    isDynamic: r.isDynamic,
 153| |    isConstantResponse: r.isConstantResponse,
 154| |    responseType: r.responseType,
 155| |    paramNames: r.paramNames,
 156| |    hooks: r.hooks,
 157| |    usage: r.usage,
 158| |  })),
 159| |});
 161|▼|export const writeArtifacts = (
 162| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 163| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 164| |  logger: Logger
 165| |): void => {
 166| |  mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
 168| |  if (opts.generateTypes) {
 169| |    const types = generateRouteTypes(routes);
 170| |    writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "routes.d.ts"), types);
 171| |    logger.info("Generated routes.d.ts");
 172| |  }
 174| |  if (opts.generateClient) {
 175| |    writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "client.d.ts"), generateClientDts());
 176| |    logger.info("Generated client.d.ts");
 177| |  }
 179| |  if (opts.generateOpenAPI) {
 180| |    const openapi = generateOpenApi(routes, opts);
 181| |    writeFileSync(
 182| |      join(opts.outDir, "openapi.json"),
 183| |      JSON.stringify(openapi, null, 2)
 184| |    );
 185| |    logger.info("Generated openapi.json");
 186| |  }
 188| |  const manifest = generateManifest(routes, opts);
 189| |  writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "manifest.json"), JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
 190| |  logger.info("Generated manifest.json");
 191| |};

  77|▼|const getConfig = (opts: CompilerOptions): CodegenConfig => ({
