  90|▼|const normalizeImportPath = (p: string): string => {
  91| |  let s = p.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|jsx)$/, "");
  92| |  if (!s.startsWith(".")) s = "./" + s;
  93| |  return s;
  94| |};
  96|▼|const handlerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  97| |  `handler_${route.handlerRef}`;
  99|▼|const methodHandlerName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 100| |  `${route.method}_${route.handlerRef}`;
 102|▼|const finalizeName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 103| |  `finalize_${route.handlerRef}`;
 105|▼|const constantBodyVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 106| |  `BODY_${route.handlerRef}`;
 108|▼|const constantInitVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 109| |  `INIT_${route.handlerRef}`;
 111|▼|const hookIdent = (name: string): string =>
 112| |  `hook_${name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_$]/g, "_")}`;
 114|▼|const hooksChainName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 115| |  `hooks_${route.handlerRef}`;
 117|▼|const cacheVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 118| |  `CACHE_${route.handlerRef}`;
 120|▼|const coreHandlerName = (route: RouteDef, hasCache: boolean): string =>
 121| |  hasCache ? `core_${route.handlerRef}` : methodHandlerName(route);
 123|▼|const validatorImportName = (route: RouteDef, kind: string): string =>
 124| |  `validate_${route.handlerRef}_${kind}`;
 126|▼|const validatorImportPath = (route: RouteDef, kind: string): string =>
 127| |  `./validators/${route.handlerRef}.${kind}.cjs`;
 129|▼|const serializerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 130| |  `serialize_${route.handlerRef}`;
 132|▼|const serializerImportPath = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 133| |  `./serializers/${route.handlerRef}.200.mjs`;
 135|▼|const tryNormalizeConstant = (route: RouteDef): string | null => {
 136| |  if (!route.isConstantResponse || !route.constantResponse) return null;
 137| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return null;
 138| |  if (route.hasValidation) return null;
 140| |  if (route.validators && Object.keys(route.validators).length > 0) {
 141| |    return null;
 142| |  }
 144| |  try {
 145| |    JSON.parse(route.constantResponse);
 146| |    return route.constantResponse;
 147| |  } catch {
 148| |    return null;
 149| |  }
 150| |};
 152|▼|const validHookNames = (
 153| |  route: RouteDef,
 154| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>
 155| |): string[] => route.hooks.filter((name) => hooks.has(name));
 157|▼|const routeReplyFn = (route: RouteDef): string => {
 158| |  if (route.responseType === "text") return "textReply";
 159| |  if (route.responseType === "html") return "htmlReply";
 160| |  if (route.responseType === "stream") return "streamReply";
 161| |  return "jsonReply";
 162| |};
 164| |const FORCE_FULL_TOKENS = [
 165| |  "ctx.cookie",
 166| |  "ctx.server",
 167| |  "ctx.set",
 168| |  "ctx.proxy",
 169| |  "ctx.forward",
 170| |  "ctx.cache",
 171| |];
 173|▼|const needsFullContext = (
 174| |  route: RouteDef,
 175| |  mod: ModuleInfo | undefined,
 176| |  cfg: CodegenConfig,
 177| |  hasHooks: boolean
 178| |): boolean => {
 179| |  if (!cfg.specializeContext) return true;
 180| |  if (hasHooks) return true;
 182| |  if (
 183| |    route.usage.cookie ||
 184| |    route.usage.set ||
 185| |    route.usage.proxy ||
 186| |    route.usage.forward ||
 187| |    route.usage.cache
 188| |  ) {
 189| |    return true;
 190| |  }
 192| |  if (mod && FORCE_FULL_TOKENS.some((token) => mod.content.includes(token))) {
 193| |    return true;
 194| |  }
 196| |  return false;
 197| |};
 199| |const getCacheConfig = (
 200| |  route: RouteDef,
 201| |  cfg: CodegenConfig
 202| |):
 203| |  | {
 204| |    ttlMs?: number;
 205| |    staleTtlMs?: number;
 206| |    vary?: string[];
 207| |  }
 208| |  | undefined => {
 209| |  if (!cfg.routeCache) return undefined;
 210| |  if (route.method !== "GET" && route.method !== "HEAD") return undefined;
 212| |  const cache = route.cache;
 213| |  if (!cache) return undefined;
 215| |  const out: {
 216| |    ttlMs?: number;
 217| |    staleTtlMs?: number;
 218| |    vary?: string[];
 219| |  } = {};
 221| |  if (typeof cache.maxAge === "number") {
 222| |    out.ttlMs = cache.maxAge * 1000;
 223| |  }
 225| |  if (typeof cache.swr === "number") {
 226| |    out.staleTtlMs = cache.swr * 1000;
 227| |  }
 229| |  if (Array.isArray(cache.vary)) {
 230| |    out.vary = [...cache.vary];
 231| |  }
 233| |  return Object.keys(out).length > 0 ? out : undefined;
 234| |};
 236|▼|const generateHookChain = (info: RouteInfo): string => {
 237| |  const route = info.route;
 239| |  const calls = info.hookNames
 240| |    .map((name) => {
 241| |      const ident = hookIdent(name);
 243| |      return `  r = await ${ident}(ctx);
 244| |  if (r instanceof Response) return r;
 245| |  if (r && typeof r === "object" && r.ok === false && r.response instanceof Response) {
 246| |    return r.response;
 247| |  }`;
 248| |    })
 249| |    .join("\n\n");
 251| |  return `async function ${hooksChainName(route)}(ctx) {
 252| |  let r;
 254| |${calls}
 256| |  return null;
 257| |}`;
 258| |};
 260|▼|const generateFinalizer = (info: RouteInfo): string => {
 261| |  const route = info.route;
 263| |  if (info.hasSerializer) {
 264| |    return `function ${finalizeName(route)}(result) {
 265| |  if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 266| |  return new Response(${serializerImportName(route)}(result), INIT_SER_${route.handlerRef});
 267| |}`;
 268| |  }
 270| |  const reply = routeReplyFn(route);
 272| |  return `function ${finalizeName(route)}(result) {
 273| |  if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 274| |  return ${reply}(result);
 275| |}`;
 276| |};
 278|▼|const generateCoreHandler = (info: RouteInfo, cfg: CodegenConfig): string => {
 279| |  const route = info.route;
 280| |  const name = coreHandlerName(route, !!info.cacheConfig);
 282| |  if (info.constantJson !== null) {
 283| |    return `function ${name}(req, params, url, server) {
 284| |  return new Response(${constantBodyVar(route)}, ${constantInitVar(route)});
 285| |}`;
 286| |  }
 288| |  const pre: string[] = [];
 289| |  let callExpr = "";
 291| |  if (info.needsFull) {
 292| |    const ctxOpts: string[] = [];
 294| |    if (info.needsBody) {
 295| |      ctxOpts.push("body: BODY_LIMITS");
 296| |    }
 298| |    const ctxOptsExpr = ctxOpts.length > 0 ? `, { ${ctxOpts.join(", ")} }` : "";
 300| |    pre.push(
 301| |      `const ctx = createContext(req, params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS${ctxOptsExpr});`
 302| |    );
 304| |    if (route.usage.server) {
 305| |      pre.push("ctx.server = server;");
 306| |    }
 308| |    if (info.hasHooks) {
 309| |      pre.push(
 310| |        `const halted = await ${hooksChainName(route)}(ctx);`
 311| |      );
 312| |      pre.push("if (halted) return halted;");
 313| |    }
 315| |    if (info.hasParamsValidator) {
 316| |      pre.push(
 317| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "params")}(ctx.params)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "params")}.errors, "params");`
 318| |      );
 319| |    }
 321| |    if (info.hasQueryValidator) {
 322| |      pre.push(
 323| |        `const __query = parseQuery(ctx.url.search.startsWith("?") ? ctx.url.search.slice(1) : "");`
 324| |      );
 325| |      pre.push(
 326| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "query")}(__query)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "query")}.errors, "query");`
 327| |      );
 328| |    }
 330| |    if (info.hasHeadersValidator) {
 331| |      pre.push(
 332| |        `const __headers = Object.fromEntries(ctx.headers.entries());`
 333| |      );
 334| |      pre.push(
 335| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "headers")}(__headers)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "headers")}.errors, "headers");`
 336| |      );
 337| |    }
 339| |    if (info.hasBodyValidator) {
 340| |      pre.push(`const __body = await ctx.body.json();`);
 341| |      pre.push(
 342| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "body")}(__body)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "body")}.errors, "body");`
 343| |      );
 344| |    }
 346| |    callExpr = `${handlerImportName(route)}(ctx)`;
 347| |  } else {
 348| |    if (route.usage.query || info.hasQueryValidator) {
 349| |      pre.push("const query = url.searchParams;");
 350| |    }
 352| |    if (info.minimalBody) {
 353| |      pre.push("const body = createLazyBody(req, BODY_LIMITS);");
 354| |    }
 356| |    if (route.usage.state) {
 357| |      pre.push("const state = new Map();");
 358| |    }
 360| |    if (info.hasParamsValidator) {
 361| |      pre.push(
 362| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "params")}(params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "params")}.errors, "params");`
 363| |      );
 364| |    }
 366| |    if (info.hasQueryValidator) {
 367| |      pre.push(
 368| |        `const __query = parseQuery(url.search.startsWith("?") ? url.search.slice(1) : "");`
 369| |      );
 370| |      pre.push(
 371| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "query")}(__query)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "query")}.errors, "query");`
 372| |      );
 373| |    }
 375| |    if (info.hasHeadersValidator) {
 376| |      pre.push(`const __headers = Object.fromEntries(req.headers.entries());`);
 377| |      pre.push(
 378| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "headers")}(__headers)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "headers")}.errors, "headers");`
 379| |      );
 380| |    }
 382| |    let bodyProp = "body";
 384| |    if (info.hasBodyValidator && info.minimalBody) {
 385| |      pre.push(`const __body = await body.json();`);
 386| |      pre.push(
 387| |        `if (!${validatorImportName(route, "body")}(__body)) throw validationError(${validatorImportName(route, "body")}.errors, "body");`
 388| |      );
 389| |      pre.push(`const validatedBody = Object.create(body);`);
 390| |      pre.push(`validatedBody.json = async () => __body;`);
 391| |      bodyProp = "validatedBody";
 392| |    }
 394| |    const props: string[] = [];
 396| |    if (route.usage.params) {
 397| |      props.push("params: params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS");
 398| |    }
 400| |    if (info.minimalBody) {
 401| |      props.push(`body: ${bodyProp}`);
 402| |    }
 404| |    if (route.usage.query) {
 405| |      props.push("query");
 406| |    }
 408| |    if (route.usage.headers) {
 409| |      props.push("headers: req.headers");
 410| |    }
 412| |    if (route.usage.req) {
 413| |      props.push("req");
 414| |    }
 416| |    if (route.usage.url) {
 417| |      props.push("url");
 418| |    }
 420| |    if (route.usage.server) {
 421| |      props.push("server");
 422| |    }
 424| |    if (route.usage.state) {
 425| |      props.push("state");
 426| |      props.push("getState: (key) => state.get(key)");
 427| |      props.push("setState: (key, value) => { state.set(key, value); }");
 428| |    }
 430| |    if (route.usage.json) {
 431| |      props.push("json: jsonReply");
 432| |    }
 434| |    if (route.usage.text) {
 435| |      props.push("text: textReply");
 436| |    }
 438| |    if (route.usage.html) {
 439| |      props.push("html: htmlReply");
 440| |    }
 442| |    if (route.usage.stream) {
 443| |      props.push("stream: streamReply");
 444| |    }
 446| |    if (route.usage.redirect) {
 447| |      props.push("redirect: redirectReply");
 448| |    }
 450| |    if (route.usage.empty) {
 451| |      props.push("empty: emptyReply");
 452| |    }
 454| |    if (route.usage.status) {
 455| |      props.push("status: (code) => new Response(null, { status: code })");
 456| |    }
 458| |    if (info.minimalSendFile) {
 459| |      props.push("sendFile: (path, opts) => coreSendFile(path, { req, ...opts })");
 460| |    }
 462| |    callExpr =
 463| |      props.length === 0
 464| |        ? `${handlerImportName(route)}({})`
 465| |        : `${handlerImportName(route)}({ ${props.join(", ")} })`;
 466| |  }
 468| |  const isAsync =
 469| |    route.isAsync ||
 470| |    info.hasHooks ||
 471| |    info.needsFull ||
 472| |    info.minimalBody ||
 473| |    info.hasBodyValidator ||
 474| |    !!info.cacheConfig ||
 475| |    route.usage.state;
 477| |  if (isAsync) {
 478| |    return `async function ${name}(req, params, url, server) {
 479| |  try {
 480| |    ${pre.join("\n    ")}
 481| |    const result = await ${callExpr};
 482| |    return ${finalizeName(route)}(result);
 483| |  } catch (err) {
 484| |    return errorResponse(err);
 485| |  }
 486| |}`;
 487| |  }
 489| |  return `function ${name}(req, params, url, server) {
 490| |  try {
 491| |    ${pre.join("\n    ")}
 492| |    const result = ${callExpr};
 493| |    if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 494| |    if (result && typeof result.then === "function") {
 495| |      return result
 496| |        .then((v) => ${finalizeName(route)}(v))
 497| |        .catch((err) => errorResponse(err));
 498| |    }
 499| |    return ${finalizeName(route)}(result);
 500| |  } catch (err) {
 501| |    return errorResponse(err);
 502| |  }
 503| |}`;
 504| |};
 506|▼|const generateCacheWrapper = (info: RouteInfo): string | null => {
 507| |  if (!info.cacheConfig) return null;
 509| |  const route = info.route;
 510| |  const opts = JSON.stringify(info.cacheConfig);
 512| |  return `function ${methodHandlerName(route)}(req, params, url, server) {
 513| |  return ${cacheVar(route)}.getOrSet(req, () => ${coreHandlerName(route, true)}(req, params, url, server), ${opts});
 514| |}`;
 515| |};
 517|▼|const escapeRegex = (value: string): string =>
 518| |  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
 520| |const routePattern = (
 521| |  path: string
 522| |): { regexLiteral: string; paramNames: string[] } => {
 523| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
 524| |  const segments = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);
 526| |  const pattern = segments
 527| |    .map((seg) => {
 528| |      if (seg.startsWith(":")) {
 529| |        paramNames.push(seg.slice(1));
 530| |        return "([^/]+)";
 531| |      }
 533| |      if (seg.startsWith("*")) {
 534| |        paramNames.push(seg.slice(1));
 535| |        return "(.*)";
 536| |      }
 538| |      return escapeRegex(seg);
 539| |    })
 540| |    .join("/");
 542| |  const source = segments.length === 0 ? "^/$" : `^/${pattern}$`;
 543| |  const regexLiteral = `/${source.replace(/\//g, "\\/")}/`;
 545| |  return { regexLiteral, paramNames };
 546| |};
 548|▼|const newTrieNode = (): TrieNode => ({
 549| |  static: new Map(),
 550| |  handlers: new Map(),
 551| |});
 553|▼|const insertDynamicRoute = (
 554| |  root: TrieNode,
 555| |  route: RouteDef,
 556| |  handlerName: string
 557| |): void => {
 558| |  let node = root;
 560| |  const segments = route.path.split("/").filter(Boolean);
 562| |  for (const seg of segments) {
 563| |    if (seg.startsWith(":")) {
 564| |      const name = seg.slice(1);
 566| |      if (!node.param) {
 567| |        node.param = { name, node: newTrieNode() };
 568| |      }
 570| |      node = node.param.node;
 571| |      continue;
 572| |    }
 574| |    if (seg.startsWith("*")) {
 575| |      const name = seg.slice(1);
 577| |      if (!node.wildcard) {
 578| |        node.wildcard = { name, node: newTrieNode() };
 579| |      }
 581| |      node = node.wildcard.node;
 582| |      continue;
 583| |    }
 585| |    if (!node.static.has(seg)) {
 586| |      node.static.set(seg, newTrieNode());
 587| |    }
 589| |    node = node.static.get(seg)!;
 590| |  }
 592| |  node.handlers.set(route.method, handlerName);
 593| |};
 595|▼|const emitTrieNode = (node: TrieNode): string => {
 596| |  const staticEntries = Array.from(node.static.entries()).map(
 597| |    ([seg, child]) => `${JSON.stringify(seg)}: ${emitTrieNode(child)}`
 598| |  );
 600| |  const param = node.param
 601| |    ? `{ name: ${JSON.stringify(node.param.name)}, node: ${emitTrieNode(node.param.node)} }`
 602| |    : "null";
 604| |  const wildcard = node.wildcard
 605| |    ? `{ name: ${JSON.stringify(node.wildcard.name)}, node: ${emitTrieNode(node.wildcard.node)} }`
 606| |    : "null";
 608| |  const handlerEntries = Array.from(node.handlers.entries()).map(
 609| |    ([method, handler]) => `${JSON.stringify(method)}: ${handler}`
 610| |  );
 612| |  return `{ s: { ${staticEntries.join(", ")} }, p: ${param}, w: ${wildcard}, h: { ${handlerEntries.join(", ")} } }`;
 613| |};

 616| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 617| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 618| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>,
 619| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 620| |): string => {
 621| |  const cfg = getConfig(opts);
   ... (612 more lines)

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 5: LINKER
   3| | * Uses esbuild for safe minification and source maps.
   4| | *
   5| | * Design:
   6| | * - Pure transform-option factories
   7| | * - No explicit undefined properties
   8| | * - Minimal IO boundary
   9| | */
  10| |import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "fs";
  11| |import { join } from "path";
  12| |import { transformSync, type TransformOptions } from "esbuild";
  13| |import type { CompilerOptions } from "../types";
  14| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  16| |const BASE_TRANSFORM: TransformOptions = {
  17| |  loader: "js",
  18| |  target: "esnext",
  19| |  format: "esm",
  20| |};
  22| |/**
  23| | * Create esbuild options for standalone minification.
  24| | */
  25|▼|const createMinifyOptions = (): TransformOptions => ({
  26| |  ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  27| |  minify: true,
  28| |});
  30| |/**
  31| | * Create esbuild options for standalone source map emission.
  32| | */
  33|▼|const createSourceMapOptions = (fileName: string): TransformOptions => ({
  34| |  ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  35| |  sourcefile: fileName,
  36| |  sourcemap: "external",
  37| |  minify: false,
  38| |});
  40| |/**
  41| | * Create linker transform options only when needed.
  42| | *
  43| | * Returning undefined signals:
  44| | * "no transform required, write original code".
  45| | */
  46|▼|const createLinkOptions = (
  47| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  48| |): TransformOptions | undefined => {
  49| |  if (!opts.minify && !opts.sourceMap) return undefined;
  51| |  const options: TransformOptions = {
  52| |    ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  53| |    minify: opts.minify,
  54| |    sourcefile: opts.outFile,
  55| |  };
  57| |  if (opts.sourceMap) {
  58| |    return {
  59| |      ...options,
  60| |      sourcemap: "external",
  61| |    };
  62| |  }
  64| |  return options;
  65| |};
  67| |/**
  68| | * Write final output and optional source map.
  69| | */
  70|▼|const writeLinkedOutput = (
  71| |  outPath: string,
  72| |  code: string,
  73| |  map: string | undefined,
  74| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  75| |): string => {
  76| |  if (opts.sourceMap && map) {
  77| |    const codeWithMap = `${code}
  78| |//# sourceMappingURL=${opts.outFile}.map`;
  80| |    writeFileSync(outPath, codeWithMap);
  81| |    writeFileSync(`${outPath}.map`, map);
  83| |    return codeWithMap;
  84| |  }
  86| |  writeFileSync(outPath, code);
  87| |  return code;
  88| |};
  90|▼|export const minifyCode = (code: string): string =>
  91| |  transformSync(code, createMinifyOptions()).code;
  93|▼|export const emitSourceMap = (fileName: string, code: string): string =>
  94| |  transformSync(code, createSourceMapOptions(fileName)).map;
  96|▼|export const runLinker = (
  97| |  code: string,
  98| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  99| |  logger: Logger,
 100| |): string =>
 101| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
 102| |    mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
 104| |    const outPath = join(opts.outDir, opts.outFile);
 105| |    const transformOptions = createLinkOptions(opts);
 107| |    if (!transformOptions) {
 108| |      writeFileSync(outPath, code);
 110| |      logger.info(
 111| |        `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(code) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,
 112| |      );
 114| |      return outPath;
 115| |    }
 117| |    const result = transformSync(code, transformOptions);
 118| |    const finalCode = writeLinkedOutput(outPath, result.code, result.map, opts);
 120| |    logger.info(
 121| |      `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(finalCode) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,
 122| |    );
 124| |    return outPath;
 125| |  });

   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 2: Serializer Precompilation
   3| | *
   4| | * Emits specialized JSON serializers for route response schemas.
   5| | */
   7| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
   8| |import { join } from "path";
  10| |import type {
  11| |  RouteDef,
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  CompilerOptions,
  14| |} from "../types";
  16| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  17| |import {
  18| |  loadRouteModule,
  19| |  isStandardSchema,
  20| |  cloneSchema,
  21| |} from "./schema-loader";
  23|▼|const serializerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  24| |  `serialize_${route.handlerRef}`;
  26|▼|const serializerFileName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  27| |  `${route.handlerRef}.200.mjs`;
  29|▼|const pickResponseSchema = (responseSchema: any): any => {
  30| |  if (!responseSchema || typeof responseSchema !== "object") {
  31| |    return undefined;
  32| |  }
  34| |  if (isStandardSchema(responseSchema)) {
  35| |    return undefined;
  36| |  }
  38| |  if ("type" in responseSchema) {
  39| |    return responseSchema;
  40| |  }
  42| |  return responseSchema[200] ?? responseSchema["200"] ?? responseSchema;
  43| |};
  45|▼|export const precompileSerializers = async (
  46| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  47| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  48| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  49| |  logger: Logger
  50| |): Promise<readonly RouteDef[]> => {
  51| |  if (!opts.precompileSerializers) {
  52| |    return routes;
  53| |  }
  55| |  let fastJson: any;
  57| |  try {
  58| |    const mod: any = await import("fast-json-stringify");
  59| |    fastJson = mod.default ?? mod;
  60| |  } catch {
  61| |    logger.warn(
  62| |      "fast-json-stringify unavailable. Serializer precompilation will be skipped."
  63| |    );
  64| |    return routes;
  65| |  }
  67| |  const serializersDir = join(opts.outDir, "serializers");
  68| |  mkdirSync(serializersDir, { recursive: true });
  70| |  const nextRoutes: RouteDef[] = [];
  72| |  for (const route of routes) {
  73| |    const isJsonRoute =
  74| |      route.responseType === "json" || route.usage.json === true;
  76| |    if (!isJsonRoute) {
  77| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
  78| |      continue;
  79| |    }
  81| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
  83| |    if (!mod || !mod.schemaExport) {
  84| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
  85| |      continue;
  86| |    }
  88| |    const routeModule = await loadRouteModule(mod.path);
  89| |    const schema = routeModule?.schema;
  91| |    if (!schema || typeof schema !== "object") {
  92| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
  93| |      continue;
  94| |    }
  96| |    const responseSchema = pickResponseSchema(schema.response);
  98| |    if (!responseSchema || isStandardSchema(responseSchema)) {
  99| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 100| |      continue;
 101| |    }
 103| |    let cloned: any;
 105| |    try {
 106| |      cloned = cloneSchema(responseSchema);
 107| |    } catch {
 108| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 109| |      continue;
 110| |    }
 112| |    try {
 113| |      // Test compile first.
 114| |      fastJson(cloned);
 116| |      const code = `import fastJson from "fast-json-stringify";
 118| |const schema = ${JSON.stringify(cloned)};
 120| |const serialize = fastJson(schema);
 122| |export default serialize;
 123| |`;
 125| |      writeFileSync(join(serializersDir, serializerFileName(route)), code);
 127| |      nextRoutes.push({
 128| |        ...route,
 129| |        serializers: {
 130| |          json: serializerImportName(route),
 131| |        },
 132| |      });
 134| |      logger.info(`Precompiled serializer for ${route.method} ${route.path}`);
 135| |    } catch {
 136| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 137| |    }
 138| |  }
 140| |  return nextRoutes;
 141| |};

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 2: Validator Precompilation
   3| | *
   4| | * Emits Ajv standalone validators for route schemas.
   5| | */
   7| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
   8| |import { join } from "path";
   9| |import Ajv from "ajv";
  10| |import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
  12| |import type {
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  ModuleInfo,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  19| |import {
  20| |  loadRouteModule,
  21| |  isStandardSchema,
  22| |  cloneSchema,
  23| |} from "./schema-loader";
  25| |const VALIDATOR_KINDS = ["body", "query", "params", "headers"] as const;
  27|▼|type ValidatorKind = (typeof VALIDATOR_KINDS)[number];
  29|▼|const validatorImportName = (
  30| |  route: RouteDef,
  31| |  kind: ValidatorKind
  32| |): string => `validate_${route.handlerRef}_${kind}`;
  34|▼|const validatorFileName = (
  35| |  route: RouteDef,
  36| |  kind: ValidatorKind
  37| |): string => `${route.handlerRef}.${kind}.cjs`;
  39|▼|export const precompileValidators = async (
  40| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  41| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  42| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  43| |  logger: Logger
  44| |): Promise<readonly RouteDef[]> => {
  45| |  if (!opts.precompileValidators) {
  46| |    return routes;
  47| |  }
  49| |  const validatorsDir = join(opts.outDir, "validators");
  50| |  mkdirSync(validatorsDir, { recursive: true });
  52| |  let standaloneCode: any;
  54| |  try {
  55| |    const standaloneModule: any = await import("ajv/dist/standalone/index.js");
  56| |    standaloneCode = standaloneModule.default ?? standaloneModule;
  57| |  } catch {
  58| |    logger.warn(
  59| |      "Ajv standalone unavailable. Validator precompilation will be skipped."
  60| |    );
  61| |    return routes;
  62| |  }
  64| |  const ajv = new Ajv({
  65| |    allErrors: true,
  66| |    strict: false,
  67| |    coerceTypes: true,
  68| |    removeAdditional: true,
  69| |    useDefaults: true,
  70| |    code: {
  71| |      source: true,
  72| |      esm: false,
  73| |    },
  74| |  });
  76| |  addFormats(ajv);
  78|▼|  const compileSchemaPart = (schemaPart: unknown): string | null => {
  79| |    if (!schemaPart || typeof schemaPart !== "object") {
  80| |      return null;
  81| |    }
  83| |    if (isStandardSchema(schemaPart)) {
  84| |      return null;
  85| |    }
  87| |    let cloned: any;
  89| |    try {
  90| |      cloned = cloneSchema(schemaPart);
  91| |    } catch {
  92| |      return null;
  93| |    }
  95| |    if (!cloned || typeof cloned !== "object") {
  96| |      return null;
  97| |    }
  99| |    if (cloned.noValidate === true) {
 100| |      return null;
 101| |    }
 103| |    delete cloned.$id;
 105| |    try {
 106| |      const validate = ajv.compile(cloned);
 107| |      const code = standaloneCode(ajv, validate);
 109| |      return `${code}
 110| |try {
 111| |  if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports && typeof module.exports === "function") {
 112| |    module.exports.default = module.exports;
 113| |  }
 114| |} catch {}
 115| |`;
 116| |    } catch {
 117| |      return null;
 118| |    }
 119| |  };
 121| |  const nextRoutes: RouteDef[] = [];
 123| |  for (const route of routes) {
 124| |    if (!route.hasValidation) {
 125| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 126| |      continue;
 127| |    }
 129| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 131| |    if (!mod || !mod.schemaExport) {
 132| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 133| |      continue;
 134| |    }
 136| |    const routeModule = await loadRouteModule(mod.path);
 137| |    const schema = routeModule?.schema;
 139| |    if (!schema || typeof schema !== "object") {
 140| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 141| |      continue;
 142| |    }
 144| |    const validators: Record<string, string> = {};
 146| |    for (const kind of VALIDATOR_KINDS) {
 147| |      const schemaPart = schema[kind];
 149| |      if (!schemaPart) {
 150| |        continue;
 151| |      }
 153| |      const code = compileSchemaPart(schemaPart);
 155| |      if (!code) {
 156| |        continue;
 157| |      }
 159| |      const file = validatorFileName(route, kind);
 160| |      writeFileSync(join(validatorsDir, file), code);
 162| |      validators[kind] = validatorImportName(route, kind);
 163| |    }
 165| |    if (Object.keys(validators).length === 0) {
 166| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 167| |      continue;
 168| |    }
 170| |    nextRoutes.push({
 171| |      ...route,
 172| |      validators: validators as any,
 173| |    });
 175| |    logger.info(`Precompiled validators for ${route.method} ${route.path}`);
 176| |  }
 178| |  return nextRoutes;
 179| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Bun.Transpiler-based AST Parser
   3| | * Replaces regex hacks with a proper ESTree walker.
   4| | * Handles edge cases: nested functions, template literals, comments, re-exports, etc.
   5| | */
   7| |import type {
   8| |  ContextUsage,
   9| |  ImportInfo,
  10| |  ExportInfo,
  11| |  SymbolInfo,
  12| |  Position,
  13| |} from "../types";
  14| |import { EMPTY_USAGE } from "../../shared/context-usage";
  15| |import * as oxcParser from "oxc-parser";
  17| |import { createRequire } from "node:module";
  18| |/**
  19| | * Build ImportInfo without assigning explicit undefined properties.
  20| | *
  21| | * This satisfies exactOptionalPropertyTypes cleanly.
  22| | */
  24|▼|const createImportInfo = (
  25| |  source: string,
  26| |  names: string[],
  27| |  defaultName?: string,
  28| |  namespaceName?: string,
  29| |): ImportInfo => {
  30| |  const info: {
  31| |    source: string;
  32| |    names: string[];
  33| |    defaultName?: string;
  34| |    namespaceName?: string;
  35| |  } = {
  36| |    source,
  37| |    names,
  38| |  };
  40| |  if (defaultName !== undefined) info.defaultName = defaultName;
  41| |  if (namespaceName !== undefined) info.namespaceName = namespaceName;
  43| |  return info;
  44| |};
  47| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48| |// ESTree Walker — tiny, zero-dependency
  49| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  51|▼|function walk(node: any, cb: (node: any) => void): void {
  52| |  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  53| |  cb(node);
  54| |  for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
  55| |    if (key === "parent" || key === "loc" || key === "range") continue;
  56| |    const child = node[key];
  57| |    if (Array.isArray(child)) {
  58| |      for (const c of child) walk(c, cb);
  59| |    } else if (child && typeof child === "object" && child.type) {
  60| |      walk(child, cb);
  61| |    }
  62| |  }
  63| |}
  65|▼|function walkUntil<T>(node: any, predicate: (node: any) => T | undefined): T | undefined {
  66| |  let result: T | undefined;
  67| |  walk(node, (n) => {
  68| |    if (result !== undefined) return;
  69| |    const r = predicate(n);
  70| |    if (r !== undefined) result = r;
  71| |  });
  72| |  return result;
  73| |}
  75| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  76| |// Context-Usage Detection
  77| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  79| |const CONTEXT_METHODS = new Set([
  80| |  "json", "text", "html", "redirect", "stream", "empty", "get", "set",
  81| |]);
  83| |const CONTEXT_PROPS = new Set([
  84| |  "body", "params", "query", "file", "files", "headers", "state", "req", "url",
  85| |  "cookie", "server", "set", "sendFile", "proxy", "forward", "cache",
  86| |]);
  88| |/** Build a map: localVariableName → contextProperty (or "__root__") */
  89|▼|function buildContextMapping(params: any[]): Map<string, string> {
  90| |  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  91| |  for (const param of params) {
  92| |    if (!param) continue;
  93| |    if (param.type === "Identifier") {
  94| |      map.set(param.name, "__root__");
  95| |    } else if (param.type === "ObjectPattern") {
  96| |      for (const prop of param.properties || []) {
  97| |        if (prop.type !== "Property") continue;
  98| |        const key = prop.key?.name ?? prop.key?.value;
  99| |        const local = prop.value?.name ?? prop.value?.value;
 100| |        if (key && local) map.set(local, key);
 101| |        // Nested destructuring not supported for DX simplicity
 102| |      }
 103| |    }
 104| |  }
 105| |  return map;
 106| |}
 108|▼|function detectUsage(bodyNode: any, mapping: Map<string, string>): ContextUsage {
 109| |  const usage: ContextUsage = { ...EMPTY_USAGE };
 111| |  walk(bodyNode, (n) => {
 112| |    if (n.type === "MemberExpression" && !n.computed && n.object?.type === "Identifier") {
 113| |      const root = mapping.get(n.object.name);
 115| |      if (root === "__root__") {
 116| |        const prop = n.property.name;
 118| |        if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 119| |        if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 120| |        if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 121| |        if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 122| |        if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 123| |        if (prop === "state" || prop === "getState" || prop === "setState") usage.state = true;
 124| |        if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 125| |        if (prop === "url" || prop === "path" || prop === "method") usage.url = true;
 127| |        if (prop === "cookie") usage.cookie = true;
 128| |        if (prop === "server") usage.server = true;
 129| |        if (prop === "set") usage.set = true;
 131| |        if (prop === "json") usage.json = true;
 132| |        if (prop === "text") usage.text = true;
 133| |        if (prop === "html") usage.html = true;
 134| |        if (prop === "redirect") usage.redirect = true;
 135| |        if (prop === "stream") usage.stream = true;
 136| |        if (prop === "empty") usage.empty = true;
 137| |        if (prop === "status") usage.status = true;
 139| |        if (prop === "sendFile") usage.sendFile = true;
 140| |        if (prop === "proxy") usage.proxy = true;
 141| |        if (prop === "forward") usage.forward = true;
 142| |        if (prop === "cache") usage.cache = true;
 143| |      }
 144| |    }
 146| |    if (n.type === "Identifier" && mapping.has(n.name)) {
 147| |      const prop = mapping.get(n.name)!;
 149| |      if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 150| |      if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 151| |      if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 152| |      if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 153| |      if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 154| |      if (prop === "state") usage.state = true;
 155| |      if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 156| |      if (prop === "url") usage.url = true;
 158| |      if (prop === "cookie") usage.cookie = true;
 159| |      if (prop === "server") usage.server = true;
 160| |      if (prop === "set") usage.set = true;
 162| |      if (prop === "sendFile") usage.sendFile = true;
 163| |      if (prop === "proxy") usage.proxy = true;
 164| |      if (prop === "forward") usage.forward = true;
 165| |      if (prop === "cache") usage.cache = true;
 166| |    }
 167| |  });
 169| |  return usage;
 170| |}
 172| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 173| |// Handler Extraction
 174| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 176| |const HTTP_WRAPPERS = new Set(["get", "post", "put", "patch", "del", "all"]);
 177|▼|const nodeStart = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 178| |  node?.range?.[0] ?? node?.start ?? node?.span?.[0];
 180|▼|const nodeEnd = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 181| |  node?.range?.[1] ?? node?.end ?? node?.span?.[1];
 183|▼|function extractHandlerFunction(node: any): { fn: any; isAsync: boolean } | null {
 184| |  // export default get(async (ctx) => ...)
 185| |  if (node.type === "CallExpression" && node.callee?.type === "Identifier" && HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(node.callee.name)) {
 186| |    const arg = node.arguments?.[0];
 187| |    if (!arg) return null;
 188| |    if (arg.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || arg.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 189| |      return { fn: arg, isAsync: arg.async ?? false };
 190| |    }
 191| |    // export default get(myHandler)
 192| |    if (arg.type === "Identifier") {
 193| |      // We can't inline a referenced handler — return null to signal "imported"
 194| |      return null;
 195| |    }
 196| |  }
 197| |  // export default (ctx) => ...
 198| |  if (node.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || node.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 199| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 200| |  }
 201| |  // export default async function(ctx) { ... }
 202| |  if (node.type === "FunctionDeclaration") {
 203| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 204| |  }
 205| |  return null;
 206| |}
 208|▼|export interface ExtractedHandler {
 209| |  readonly body: string;        // source slice of function body
 210| |  readonly isAsync: boolean;
 211| |  readonly paramName: string;  // first param identifier name (or "ctx" fallback)
 212| |  readonly usage: ContextUsage;
 213| |}
 215|▼|export function extractHandler(source: string, ast: any): ExtractedHandler | null {
 216| |  const defaultExport = walkUntil<any>(ast, (n) =>
 217| |    n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? n : undefined
 218| |  );
 220| |  if (!defaultExport) return null;
 222| |  const extracted = extractHandlerFunction(defaultExport.declaration);
 223| |  if (!extracted) return null;
 225| |  const { fn, isAsync } = extracted;
 226| |  const params = fn.params || [];
 227| |  const mapping = buildContextMapping(params);
 228| |  const rootParam = params[0]?.type === "Identifier" ? params[0].name : "ctx";
 230| |  let bodyText = "";
 231| |  const body = fn.body;
 233| |  if (body) {
 234| |    const start = nodeStart(body);
 235| |    const end = nodeEnd(body);
 237| |    if (start != null && end != null) {
 238| |      if (body.type === "BlockStatement") {
 239| |        bodyText = source.slice(start + 1, end - 1).trim();
 240| |      } else {
 241| |        bodyText = `return ${source.slice(start, end).trim()};`;
 242| |      }
 243| |    }
 244| |  }
 246| |  const usage = detectUsage(body || fn, mapping);
 248| |  return {
 249| |    body: bodyText,
 250| |    isAsync,
 251| |    paramName: rootParam,
 252| |    usage,
 253| |  };
 254| |}
 255| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 256| |// Import / Export / Symbol Extraction (AST-based, zero regex)
 257| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 259|▼|export function extractImportsAST(ast: any): ImportInfo[] {
 260| |  const imports: ImportInfo[] = [];
 262| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 263| |    if (n.type !== "ImportDeclaration") return;
 265| |    const source = n.source?.value as string;
 266| |    if (!source) return;
 268| |    const names: string[] = [];
 269| |    let defaultName: string | undefined;
 270| |    let namespaceName: string | undefined;
 272| |    for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 273| |      if (spec.type === "ImportDefaultSpecifier") defaultName = spec.local.name;
 274| |      if (spec.type === "ImportNamespaceSpecifier") namespaceName = spec.local.name;
 275| |      if (spec.type === "ImportSpecifier") names.push(spec.local.name);
 276| |    }
 278| |    imports.push(createImportInfo(source, names, defaultName, namespaceName));
 279| |  });
 281| |  return imports;
 282| |}
 284|▼|export function extractExportsAST(ast: any): ExportInfo[] {
 285| |  const exports: ExportInfo[] = [];
 286| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 287| |    if (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration") {
 288| |      const name = n.declaration?.name || "default";
 289| |      exports.push({ name, kind: "default" });
 290| |    }
 291| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration") {
 292| |      for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 293| |        if (spec.type === "ExportSpecifier") {
 294| |          exports.push({ name: spec.local.name, kind: "named" });
 295| |        }
 296| |      }
 297| |      for (const decl of n.declaration ? [n.declaration] : []) {
 298| |        if (decl.type === "FunctionDeclaration" || decl.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 299| |          const id = decl.id || decl.declarations?.[0]?.id;
 300| |          if (id?.name) exports.push({ name: id.name, kind: "named" });
 301| |        }
 302| |      }
 303| |    }
 304| |  });
 305| |  return exports;
 306| |}
 308|▼|function posFromNode(source: string, node: any): Position {
 309| |  if (node.loc) return { line: node.loc.start.line, column: node.loc.start.column };
 310| |  return { line: 0, column: 0 };
 311| |}
 313|▼|export function extractSymbolsAST(source: string, ast: any): SymbolInfo[] {
 314| |  const symbols: SymbolInfo[] = [];
 315| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 316| |    if (n.type === "FunctionDeclaration" && n.id?.name) {
 317| |      symbols.push({
 318| |        name: n.id.name,
 319| |        kind: "function",
 320| |        pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 321| |        isAsync: n.async ?? false,
 322| |        isDefaultExport: false,
 323| |        params: (n.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 324| |        decorators: [],
 325| |        calls: [],
 326| |        calledBy: [],
 327| |        size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 328| |        hotness: 0,
 329| |      });
 330| |    }
 331| |    if (n.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 332| |      for (const decl of n.declarations || []) {
 333| |        if (decl.id?.name && decl.init?.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression") {
 334| |          symbols.push({
 335| |            name: decl.id.name,
 336| |            kind: "const",
 337| |            pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 338| |            isAsync: decl.init.async ?? false,
 339| |            isDefaultExport: false,
 340| |            params: (decl.init.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 341| |            decorators: [],
 342| |            calls: [],
 343| |            calledBy: [],
 344| |            size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 345| |            hotness: 0,
 346| |          });
 347| |        }
 348| |      }
 349| |    }
 350| |  });
 351| |  return symbols;
 352| |}
 354|▼|export function hasDefaultExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 355| |  return walkUntil(ast, (n) => (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? true : undefined)) ?? false;
 356| |}
 358|▼|export function hasSchemaExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 359| |  let found = false;
 360| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 361| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 362| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 363| |        if (d.id?.name === "schema") found = true;
 364| |      }
 365| |    }
 366| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "schema") found = true;
 368| |    // Schema-first HTTP: export default get(handler, { ... })
 369| |    if (
 370| |      n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" &&
 371| |      n.declaration?.type === "CallExpression" &&
 372| |      n.declaration.callee?.type === "Identifier" &&
 373| |      HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(n.declaration.callee.name)
 374| |    ) {
 375| |      const args = n.declaration.arguments || [];
 376| |      const schemaArg = args[1];
 378| |      if (
 379| |        schemaArg &&
 380| |        schemaArg.type !== "Literal" &&
 381| |        schemaArg.type !== "StringLiteral" &&
 382| |        schemaArg.type !== "TemplateLiteral"
 383| |      ) {
 384| |        found = true;
 385| |      }
 386| |    }
 387| |  });
 388| |  return found;
 389| |}
 391|▼|export function hasConfigExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 392| |  let found = false;
 393| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 394| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 395| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 396| |        if (d.id?.name === "config") found = true;
 397| |      }
 398| |    }
 399| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "config") found = true;
 400| |  });
 401| |  return found;
 402| |}
 404| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 405| |// Purity Analysis (AST-based)
 406| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 408| |const IMPURE_GLOBALS = new Set([
 409| |  "fetch", "Date", "Math", "console", "process", "crypto",
 410| |  "setTimeout", "setInterval", "clearTimeout", "clearInterval",
 411| |  "Promise", "Map", "Set", "WeakMap", "WeakSet",
 412| |]);
 414| |const IMPURE_CALLS = new Set([
 415| |  "Math.random", "Date.now", "crypto.randomUUID", "crypto.getRandomValues",
 416| |  "console.log", "console.warn", "console.error", "fetch",
 417| |]);
 419|▼|export function isPureBodyAST(ast: any): boolean {
 420| |  let impure = false;
 421| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 422| |    if (impure) return;
 423| |    // new Date(), new Map(), etc.
 424| |    if (n.type === "NewExpression" && n.callee?.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(n.callee.name)) {
 425| |      impure = true;
 426| |    }
 427| |    // fetch(), Math.random(), etc.
 428| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression") {
 429| |      const callee = n.callee;
 430| |      if (callee.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(callee.name)) {
 431| |        impure = true;
 432| |      }
 433| |      if (callee.type === "MemberExpression") {
 434| |        const chain = flattenMember(callee);
 435| |        if (chain && IMPURE_CALLS.has(chain)) impure = true;
 436| |      }
 437| |    }
 438| |    // await
 439| |    if (n.type === "AwaitExpression") {
 440| |      // Conservative: any await is impure (could be DB, fetch, etc.)
 441| |      impure = true;
 442| |    }
 443| |  });
 444| |  return !impure;
 445| |}
 447|▼|function flattenMember(node: any): string | null {
 448| |  if (node.type === "Identifier") return node.name;
 449| |  if (node.type === "MemberExpression" && !node.computed) {
 450| |    const obj = flattenMember(node.object);
 451| |    const prop = node.property?.name;
 452| |    if (obj && prop) return `${obj}.${prop}`;
 453| |  }
 454| |  return null;
 455| |}
 457| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 458| |// Response-Type Inference (AST-based)
 459| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 461|▼|export function inferResponseTypeAST(ast: any): "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" {
 462| |  let type: "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" = "unknown";
 463| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 464| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression" && n.callee?.type === "MemberExpression") {
 465| |      const chain = flattenMember(n.callee);
 466| |      if (chain === "ctx.json") type = "json";
 467| |      if (chain === "ctx.text") type = "text";
 468| |      if (chain === "ctx.html") type = "html";
 469| |      if (chain === "ctx.stream") type = "stream";
 470| |    }
 471| |    // Heuristic: return "string" or template literal → text
 472| |    if (n.type === "ReturnStatement" && n.argument?.type === "Literal" && typeof n.argument.value === "string") {
 473| |      if (type === "unknown") type = "text";
 474| |    }
 475| |  });
 476| |  return type;
 477| |}

 483|▼|export interface ParseResult {
 484| |  readonly ast: any;
 485| |  readonly imports: ImportInfo[];
 486| |  readonly exports: ExportInfo[];
 487| |  readonly symbols: SymbolInfo[];
 488| |  readonly hasDefaultExport: boolean;
 489| |  readonly schemaExport: boolean;
 490| |  readonly configExport: boolean;

 492| |  readonly config?: any;
 493| |}
 495| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 496| |// AST Parser Bridge

 499|▼|function normalizeAst(result: any): any {
 500| |  if (!result) {
 501| |    return { type: "Program", body: [] };
 502| |  }
 504| |  if (result.errors && result.errors.length > 0) {
 505|!|    throw new Error(result.errors[0]?.message ?? "AST parse error");
 506| |  }
 508| |  const ast = result.program ?? result.ast ?? result.root ?? result;
 510| |  if (!ast.type) ast.type = "Program";
 511| |  if (!Array.isArray(ast.body)) ast.body = [];
 513| |  return ast;
 514| |}
 516|▼|function tryOxcParser(source: string): any | undefined {
 517| |  const mod = oxcParser as any;
 518| |  const parseSync = mod.parseSync ?? mod.default?.parseSync;
 520| |  if (typeof parseSync !== "function") return undefined;
 522| |  const attempts = [
 523| |    () =>
 524| |      parseSync("flux.ts", source, {
 525| |        sourceType: "module",
 526| |        target: "esnext",
 527| |      }),
 528| |    () =>
 529| |      parseSync(source, {
 530| |        sourceType: "module",
 531| |        target: "esnext",
 532| |      }),
 533| |  ];
 535| |  for (const attempt of attempts) {
 536| |    try {
 537| |      const result = attempt();
 539| |      if (result && typeof result.then === "function") continue;
 540| |      if (result?.errors?.length) continue;
 542| |      const program = result?.program ?? result?.ast ?? result;
 544| |      if (program?.type || Array.isArray(program?.body)) {
 545| |        return program;
 546| |      }
 547| |    } catch {
 548| |      // try next shape
 549| |    }
 550| |  }
 552| |  return undefined;
 553| |}

 556| |  const oxc = tryOxcParser(source);
 557| |  if (oxc) return normalizeAst(oxc);
 559| |  const B: any = Bun;
 561| |  const parsers: Array<() => any> = [
 562| |    () =>
 563| |      typeof B.parse === "function"
 564| |        ? B.parse(source, {
 565| |            loader: "ts",
 566| |            target: "bun",
 567| |            ranges: true,
 568| |            loc: true,
 569| |          })
 570| |        : undefined,
 572| |    () =>
 573| |      typeof B.parseSync === "function"
 574| |        ? B.parseSync(source, {
 575| |            loader: "ts",
 576| |            target: "bun",
 577| |            ranges: true,
 578| |            loc: true,
 579| |          })
 580| |        : undefined,
 582| |    () => {
   ... (110 more lines)

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview OpenAPI 3.1 Specification Generator.
   3| | * Auto-generates docs from route definitions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { RouteSchema, DocumentDecoration, HttpMethod } from "./types";
   8|▼|export interface OpenAPIInfo {
   9| |    title: string;
  10| |    version: string;
  11| |    description?: string;
  12| |}
  14|▼|export interface RouteDefinition {
  15| |    method: HttpMethod;
  16| |    path: string;
  17| |    schema?: RouteSchema;
  18| |    detail?: DocumentDecoration;
  19| |}
  21|▼|export const generateOpenAPI = (
  22| |    info: OpenAPIInfo,
  23| |    routes: RouteDefinition[]
  24| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  25| |    const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  27| |    for (const route of routes) {
  28| |        if (route.method === "ALL" || route.method === "WS") continue;
  30| |        const openApiPath = route.path
  31| |            .replace(/:(\w+)/g, "{$1}")
  32| |            .replace(/\*(\w+)/g, "{$1}");
  34| |        if (!paths[openApiPath]) paths[openApiPath] = {};
  36| |        const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
  37| |            operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
  38| |            ...route.detail,
  39| |            responses: { "200": { description: "Successful response" } },
  40| |        };
  42| |        if (route.schema?.params) {
  43| |            const schema = route.schema.params as any;
  44| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  46| |            operation.parameters = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  47| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  48| |                    name,
  49| |                    in: "path",
  50| |                    required: required.has(name),
  51| |                    schema: {
  52| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  53| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  54| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  55| |                    },
  56| |                })
  57| |            );
  58| |        }
  60| |        if (route.schema?.query) {
  61| |            const schema = route.schema.query as any;
  62| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  64| |            const queryParams = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  65| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  66| |                    name,
  67| |                    in: "query",
  68| |                    required: required.has(name),
  69| |                    schema: {
  70| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  71| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  72| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  73| |                        ...(propSchema.default !== undefined
  74| |                            ? { default: propSchema.default }
  75| |                            : {}),
  76| |                    },
  77| |                })
  78| |            );
  80| |            operation.parameters = [
  81| |                ...((operation.parameters as any[]) ?? []),
  82| |                ...queryParams,
  83| |            ];
  85| |        }
  87| |        if (route.schema?.body) {
  88| |            operation.requestBody = {
  89| |                content: { "application/json": { schema: route.schema.body } },
  90| |            };
  91| |        }
  93| |        paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
  94| |    }
  96| |    return {
  97| |        openapi: "3.1.0",
  98| |        info,
  99| |        paths,
 100| |    };
 101| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * Runtime schema validation.
   3| | *
   4| | * Supports:
   5| | * - TypeBox / JSON Schema via Ajv
   6| | * - Standard Schema v1 via async validation
   7| | */
   9| |import Ajv, { type ErrorObject } from "ajv";
  10| |import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
  11| |import type { AnySchema, StandardSchemaV1 } from "./types";
  12| |import { ValidationError } from "./errors";
  14| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  15| |  allErrors: true,
  16| |  strict: false,
  17| |  coerceTypes: true,
  18| |  removeAdditional: true,
  19| |  useDefaults: true,
  20| |});
  22| |addFormats(ajv);
  24|▼|function isStandardSchema(schema: AnySchema): schema is StandardSchemaV1 {
  25| |  return typeof schema === "object" && schema !== null && "~standard" in schema;
  26| |}
  28|▼|function toErrorRecord(
  29| |  errors: ErrorObject[] | null | undefined,
  30| |  on: string
  31| |): Record<string, string[]> {
  32| |  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  34| |  for (const e of errors ?? []) {
  35| |    const path =
  36| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
  37| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
  38| |      on;
  40| |    out[path] ??= [];
  41| |    out[path].push(e.message ?? "Invalid value");
  42| |  }
  44| |  return out;
  45| |}
  47|▼|export function compileValidator<T = unknown>(
  48| |  schema: AnySchema,
  49| |  on: string = "input"
  50| |) {
  51| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
  52| |    return (_input: unknown): T => {
  53|!|      throw new Error(
  54| |        "Standard Schema validators are async. Use validateAsync() instead of compileValidator()."
  55| |      );
  56| |    };
  57| |  }
  59| |  const validate = ajv.compile(schema as object);
  61| |  return (input: unknown): T => {
  62| |    if (!validate(input)) {
  63|!|      throw new ValidationError(
  64| |        "Validation failed",
  65| |        toErrorRecord(validate.errors, on),
  66| |        on
  67| |      );
  68| |    }
  70| |    return input as T;
  71| |  };
  72| |}
  74|▼|export function validateOrThrow<T = unknown>(
  75| |  schema: AnySchema,
  76| |  input: unknown,
  77| |  on: string = "input"
  78| |): T {
  79| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
  80| |}
  82|▼|export async function validateAsync<T = unknown>(
  83| |  schema: AnySchema,
  84| |  input: unknown,
  85| |  on: string = "input"
  86| |): Promise<T> {
  87| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
  88| |    const result = await schema["~standard"].validate(input);
  90| |    if ("issues" in result) {
  91| |      const errors: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  93| |      for (const issue of result.issues) {
  94| |        const path = issue.path?.join(".") || on;
  95| |        errors[path] ??= [];
  96| |        errors[path].push(issue.message);
  97| |      }
  99|!|      throw new ValidationError("Validation failed", errors, on);
 100| |    }
 102| |    return result.value as T;
 103| |  }
 105| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
 106| |}

  77| |/**
  78| | * Convert a cookie value into a string representation.
  79| | */
  80|▼|const toCookieValue = (value: unknown): string =>
  81| |  typeof value === "object" && value !== null
  82| |    ? JSON.stringify(value)
  83| |    : String(value ?? "");
  85| |/**
  86| | * Encode cookie value safely.
  87| | */
  88|▼|const encodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => encodeURIComponent(value);
  90| |/**
  91| | * Decode cookie value with fallback for malformed values.
  92| | */
  93|▼|const decodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => {
  94| |  try {
  95| |    return decodeURIComponent(value);
  96| |  } catch {
  97| |    return value;
  98| |  }
  99| |};
 101| |/**
 102| | * Normalize SameSite attribute.
 103| | */
 104|▼|const normalizeSameSite = (
 105| |  sameSite: CookieOptions["sameSite"],
 106| |): string | undefined => {
 107| |  if (sameSite === true) return "Strict";
 108| |  if (sameSite === false || sameSite === undefined) return undefined;
 110| |  return sameSite.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sameSite.slice(1);
 111| |};
 113| |/**
 114| | * Serialize one cookie pair.
 115| | */
 116|▼|const serializeCookiePair = (
 117| |  name: string,
 118| |  value: string,
 119| |  opts: ElysiaCookie,
 120| |): string => {
 121| |  const parts = [`${name}=${encodeCookieValue(value)}`];
 123| |  if (opts.domain) parts.push(`Domain=${opts.domain}`);
 124| |  if (opts.path) parts.push(`Path=${opts.path}`);
 126| |  if (opts.expires instanceof Date) {
 127| |    parts.push(`Expires=${opts.expires.toUTCString()}`);
 128| |  }
 130| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
 131| |    parts.push(`Max-Age=${Math.floor(opts.maxAge)}`);
 132| |  }
 134| |  if (opts.httpOnly) parts.push("HttpOnly");
 135| |  if (opts.secure) parts.push("Secure");
 137| |  const sameSite = normalizeSameSite(opts.sameSite);
 138| |  if (sameSite) parts.push(`SameSite=${sameSite}`);
 140| |  if (opts.priority) parts.push(`Priority=${opts.priority}`);
 141| |  if (opts.partitioned) parts.push("Partitioned");
 143| |  return parts.join("; ");
 144| |};
 146|▼|export const serializeCookie = (
 147| |  cookies: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 148| |): string | string[] | undefined => {
 149| |  const serialized = Object.entries(cookies)
 150| |    .filter(([, opts]) => opts?.value != null)
 151| |    .map(([name, opts]) =>
 152| |      serializeCookiePair(name, toCookieValue(opts.value), opts),
 153| |    );
 155| |  if (serialized.length === 0) return undefined;
 157| |  return serialized.length === 1 ? serialized[0] : serialized;
 158| |};
 160|▼|export const parseCookieString = (
 161| |  cookieString: string | null,
 162| |): Record<string, string> => {
 163| |  if (!cookieString) return {};
 165| |  return cookieString
 166| |    .split(";")
 167| |    .reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, segment) => {
 168| |      const eq = segment.indexOf("=");
 169| |      if (eq === -1) return acc;
 171| |      const key = segment.slice(0, eq).trim();
 172| |      if (!key) return acc;
 174| |      const value = segment.slice(eq + 1).trim();
 175| |      acc[key] = decodeCookieValue(value);
 177| |      return acc;
 178| |    }, {});
 179| |};
 181|▼|export const parseSetCookieHeader = (
 182| |  header: string | string[] | null,
 183| |) => {
 184| |  if (!header) return [];
 185| |  return setCookie.parse(header);
 186| |};
 188| |// ============================================================================
 189| |// Cookie Class
 190| |// ============================================================================
 192|▼|export class Cookie<T = string | undefined> {
 193| |  constructor(
 194| |    private name: string,
 195| |    private jar: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 196| |    private initial: Partial<ElysiaCookie> = {}
 197| |  ) { }
 199| |  get value(): T { return (this.jar[this.name]?.value ?? this.initial.value) as T; }
 200| |  set value(v: T) {
 201| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 202| |    entry.value = v;
 203| |  }
 205| |  get expires() { return this.jar[this.name]?.expires ?? this.initial.expires; }
 206| |  set expires(v: Date | undefined) { this._set("expires", v); }
 208| |  get maxAge() { return this.jar[this.name]?.maxAge ?? this.initial.maxAge; }
 209| |  set maxAge(v: number | undefined) { this._set("maxAge", v); }
 211| |  get domain() { return this.jar[this.name]?.domain ?? this.initial.domain; }
 212| |  set domain(v: string | undefined) { this._set("domain", v); }
 214| |  get path() { return this.jar[this.name]?.path ?? this.initial.path; }
 215| |  set path(v: string | undefined) { this._set("path", v); }
 217| |  get secure() { return this.jar[this.name]?.secure ?? this.initial.secure; }
 218| |  set secure(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("secure", v); }
 220| |  get httpOnly() { return this.jar[this.name]?.httpOnly ?? this.initial.httpOnly; }
 221| |  set httpOnly(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("httpOnly", v); }
 223| |  get sameSite() { return this.jar[this.name]?.sameSite ?? this.initial.sameSite; }
 224| |  set sameSite(v: true | false | "lax" | "strict" | "none" | undefined) { this._set("sameSite", v); }
 226| |  update(config: Partial<ElysiaCookie>): this {
 227| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 228| |    Object.assign(entry, config);
 229| |    return this;
 230| |  }
 232| |  remove(): this {
 233| |    this.update({ expires: new Date(0), maxAge: 0, value: "" });
 234| |    return this;
 235| |  }
 237| |  toString(): string {
 238| |    const v = this.value;
 239| |    return typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v ?? "");
 240| |  }
 242| |  private _set(key: string, value: unknown) {
 243| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 244| |    (entry as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = value;
 245| |  }
 246| |}
 248| |// ============================================================================
 249| |// Cookie Jar Factory
 250| |// ============================================================================
 252|▼|export const createCookieJar = (
 253| |  set: SetHeaders,
 254| |  store: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 255| |  initial?: Partial<ElysiaCookie>
 256| |): Record<string, Cookie> => {
 257| |  if (!set.cookie) set.cookie = Object.create(null);
 258| |  return new Proxy(store, {
 259| |    get(_, key: string) {
 260| |      return new Cookie(key, set.cookie!, { ...initial, ...store[key] });
 261| |    }
 262| |  }) as Record<string, Cookie>;
 263| |};

 268| |// Context Factory
 269| |// ============================================================================
 271| |const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 272| |const HDR_TEXT = { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" };
 273| |const HDR_HTML = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
 275| |let requestIdCounter = 0;
 276|▼|const generateRequestId = (): string => {
 277| |  const ts = performance.now().toString(36).replace(".", "");
 278| |  const seq = (++requestIdCounter).toString(36);
 279| |  return `${ts}-${seq}`;
 280| |};
 282|▼|type ResponseHeadersInit = NonNullable<ResponseInit["headers"]>;
 284|▼|type FluxHeadersInit =
 285| |  | ResponseHeadersInit
 286| |  | Record<string, string | undefined>
 287| |  | Array<[string, string | undefined]>;
 289|▼|const asResponseHeaders = (headers: Headers): ResponseHeadersInit =>
 290| |  headers as unknown as ResponseHeadersInit;
 292| |/**
 293| | * Merge base headers with optional init headers.
 294| | * Filters undefined header values to satisfy exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
 295| | */
 296|▼|const mergeHeaders = (
 297| |  base: Record<string, string>,
 298| |  init?: FluxHeadersInit,
 299| |): ResponseHeadersInit => {
 300| |  const headers = new Headers(base);
 302| |  if (init === undefined) {
 303| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 304| |  }
 306| |  const forEachFn = (init as { forEach?: unknown }).forEach;
 308| |  if (!Array.isArray(init) && typeof forEachFn === "function") {
 309| |    (forEachFn as (cb: (value: string, key: string) => void) => void).call(
 310| |      init,
 311| |      (value, key) => {
 312| |        headers.set(key, value);
 313| |      },
 314| |    );
 316| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 317| |  }
 319| |  if (Array.isArray(init)) {
 320| |    for (const [key, value] of init as Array<[string, string | undefined]>) {
 321| |      if (value !== undefined) {
 322| |        headers.set(key, value);
 323| |      }
 324| |    }
 326| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 327| |  }
 329| |  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(
 330| |    init as Record<string, string | undefined>,
 331| |  )) {
 332| |    if (value !== undefined) {
 333| |      headers.set(key, value);
 334| |    }
 335| |  }
 337| |  return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 338| |};
 340|▼|const createResponseInit = (
 341| |  status: number,
 342| |  headers?: FluxHeadersInit,
 343| |): ResponseInit => {
 344| |  if (headers === undefined) {
 345| |    return { status };
 346| |  }
 348| |  return {
 349| |    status,
 350| |    headers: mergeHeaders({}, headers),
 351| |  };
 352| |};
 354| |const defaultCache = new HttpResponseCache({ max: 1000, ttlMs: 60_000, staleTtlMs: 300_000 });
 356| |export function createContext<P = Record<string, string>>(
 357| |  req: Request,
 358| |  params: P,
 359| |  opts: ContextOptions = {}
 360| |): FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> {
 361| |  let _url: URL | undefined;
 362| |  let _query: URLSearchParams | undefined = opts.query;
 364| |  const body = opts.bodyInstance ?? createLazyBody(req, opts.body);
 365| |  const state = new Map<string | symbol, unknown>();
 366| |  const set: SetHeaders = { headers: {}, status: 200, ...opts.set };
 368| |  const cookieStore = parseCookieString(req.headers.get("cookie"));
 369| |  const cookie = createCookieJar(set, cookieStore as any);
 371| |  const ctx: FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> = {
 372| |    req,
 373| |    get url() { return (_url ??= new URL(req.url)); },
 374| |    method: req.method as HttpMethod,
 375| |    get path() { return this.url.pathname; },
 376| |    route: "",
 377| |    headers: req.headers,
 378| |    requestId: generateRequestId(),
 379| |    startTime: performance.now(),
 380| |    params,
 381| |    get query() { return (_query ??= this.url.searchParams) as URLSearchParams; },
 382| |    body,
 383| |    cookie,
 384| |    state,
 387| |    getState<T = unknown>(key: string | symbol): T | undefined {
 388| |      return state.get(key) as T | undefined;
 389| |    },
 391| |    setState<T>(key: string | symbol, value: T): void {
 392| |      state.set(key, value);
 393| |    },
 394| |    json<T>(data: T, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 395| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 397| |      return Response.json(data, {
 398| |        status,
 399| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_JSON, init?.headers),
 400| |      });
 401| |    },
 403| |    text(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 404| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 406| |      return new Response(data, {
 407| |        status,
 408| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_TEXT, init?.headers),
 409| |      });
 410| |    },
 412| |    html(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 413| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 415| |      return new Response(data, {
 416| |        status,
 417| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_HTML, init?.headers),
 418| |      });
 419| |    },
 421| |    stream(stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 422| |      return new Response(
 423| |        stream,
 424| |        createResponseInit(init?.status ?? 200, init?.headers),
 425| |      );
 426| |    },
 427| |    empty(status = 204): Response {
 428| |      return new Response(null, { status });
 429| |    },
 430| |    status(code: number): Response {
 431| |      return new Response(null, { status: code });
 432| |    },
 434| |    sendFile(path: string, sendOpts: SendFileOptions = {}) {
 435| |      return sendFile(path, { req, ...sendOpts });
 436| |    },
 437|→|    proxy(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 438| |      return proxyRequest(target, proxyOpts);
 439| |    },
 440| |    forward(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 441| |      return forwardRequest(req, target, proxyOpts);
 442| |    },
 443|→|    cache(factory: () => Promise<Response>, cacheOpts = {}) {
 444| |      return defaultCache.getOrSet(req, factory, cacheOpts);
 445| |    },
 446| |    redirect(
 447| |      url: string,
 448| |      status: 301 | 302 | 303 | 307 | 308 = 302,
 449| |    ): Response {
 450| |      return Response.redirect(url, status);
 451| |    },
 452| |    server: null,
 453| |  };
 455| |  return ctx;
 456| |}

  file: string

f:parseModule(
  filePath: string,
  relPath: string,
  content: string,

f:runDiscovery(opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger):DiscoveryResult
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 1: DISCOVERY
   3| | * Scans filesystem for route files and extracts module metadata via AST.
   4| | * IO isolated in entry function. Pure functions do parsing.
   5| | * Now with functional composition and error recovery.
   6| | */
   8| |import { readdirSync, statSync, readFileSync } from "fs";
   9| |import { join, dirname, basename, extname } from "path";
  11| |import type {
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  HttpMethod,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  DiscoveryResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { HTTP_METHODS } from "../types";
  20| |import { parseModule as parseModuleAST } from "../utils/ast";
  21| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22| |import { tryCatch } from "../fp";
  24| |// Pure Functions
  25|▼|export const isRouteFile = (entry: string): boolean =>
  26| |  /\.(ts|js|mjs|tsx|jsx)$/.test(entry) && !entry.endsWith(".d.ts");
  28|▼|export const isValidDir = (entry: string): boolean =>
  29| |  !entry.startsWith(".") && entry !== "node_modules";
  31| |/** Safely read directory, returning empty array on error. */
  32|▼|const safeReaddir = (dir: string): string[] => {
  33| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readdirSync(dir));
  34| |  return result.ok ? result.value : [];
  35| |};
  37| |/** Safely check if path is directory. */
  38|▼|const safeIsDir = (path: string): boolean => {
  39| |  const result = tryCatch(() => statSync(path).isDirectory());
  40| |  return result.ok ? result.value : false;
  41| |};
  43| |/** Safely read file, returning empty string on error. */
  44|▼|const safeReadFile = (path: string): string => {
  45| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readFileSync(path, "utf-8"));
  46| |  return result.ok ? result.value : "";
  47| |};
  48|▼|export const scanDirectory = (dir: string, base = ""): string[] => {
  49| |  const out: string[] = [];
  50| |  for (const entry of safeReaddir(dir)) {
  51| |    const abs = join(dir, entry);
  52| |    const rel = join(base, entry).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  53| |    if (safeIsDir(abs)) {
  54| |      if (isValidDir(entry)) {
  55| |        out.push(...scanDirectory(abs, rel));
  56| |      }
  57| |    } else if (isRouteFile(entry)) {
  58| |      out.push(rel);
  59| |    }
  60| |  }
  61| |  return out;
  62| |};
  64|▼|export const parseRouteFilename = (
  65| |  file: string
  66| |): Pick<RouteDef, "method" | "path" | "paramNames" | "isDynamic" | "isStatic" | "segmentCount"> | null => {
  67| |  const ext = extname(file);
  68| |  const name = basename(file, ext);
  69| |  const parts = name.split(".");
  71| |  let method: HttpMethod = "GET";
  72| |  let routeName = name;
  74| |  const lastPart = parts.at(-1);
  75| |  if (lastPart && HTTP_METHODS.includes(lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod)) {
  76| |    method = lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod;
  77| |    routeName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(".");
  78| |  }
  80| |  const dirPart = dirname(file);
  81| |  let routePath = "/" + join(dirPart, routeName).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  82| |  if (routePath.endsWith("/index")) {
  83| |    routePath = routePath.slice(0, -5) || "/";
  84| |  }
  86| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
  87| |  let isDynamic = false;
  89| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[(\.\.\.[^\]]+)\]/g, (_, raw: string) => {
  90| |    isDynamic = true;
  91| |    const pname = raw.slice(3);
  92| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  93| |    return "*" + pname;
  94| |  });
  96| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (_, pname: string) => {
  97| |    isDynamic = true;
  98| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  99| |    return ":" + pname;
 100| |  });
 102| |  return {
 103| |    method,
 104| |    path: routePath,
 105| |    paramNames,
 106| |    isDynamic,
 107| |    isStatic: !isDynamic,
 108| |    segmentCount: routePath.split("/").filter(Boolean).length,
 109| |  };
 110| |};
 112|▼|export const parseModule = (
 113| |  filePath: string,
 114| |  relPath: string,
 115| |  content: string,
 116| |): ModuleInfo => {
 117| |  const parsed = parseModuleAST(content);
 119| |  return {
 120| |    path: filePath,
 121| |    relPath,
 122| |    content,
 123| |    imports: parsed.imports,
 124| |    exports: parsed.exports,
 125| |    symbols: parsed.symbols,
 126| |    hasDefaultExport: parsed.hasDefaultExport,
 127| |    callGraph: new Map(),
 128| |    dataFlow: new Map(),
 130| |    ...(parsed.schemaExport ? { schemaExport: "schema" } : {}),
 131| |    ...(parsed.configExport ? { configExport: "config" } : {}),
 132| |  };
 133| |};
 135| |// Phase Orchestrator — Functional composition
 136|▼|export const runDiscovery = (opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger): DiscoveryResult =>
 137| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
 138| |    const files = scanDirectory(opts.routesDir);
 139| |    const modules = files.map(f => {
 140| |      const abs = join(opts.routesDir, f);
 141| |      const content = safeReadFile(abs);
 142| |      return parseModule(abs, f, content);
 143| |    }).filter(m => m.content.length > 0); // Skip unreadable files
 145| |    logger.info(`Discovered ${files.length} files, ${modules.length} modules`, {
 146| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 147| |    });
 148| |    return { files, modules };
 149| |  });
---

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 3: OPTIMIZATION
   3| | *
   4| | * Production cleanup:
   5| | * - removed jump table generation
   6| | * - removed dense/sparse/perfect-hash tables
   7| | * - removed response preserialization buffers
   8| | * - removed Zod-specific schema compilation
   9| | * - kept inline detection and deduplication
  10| | */
  12| |import type {
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  ModuleInfo,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  OptimizationResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { estimateNodeCount } from "../utils/ast";
  20| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22|▼|export const isInlineEligible = (
  23| |  route: RouteDef,
  24| |  mod: ModuleInfo | undefined,
  25| |  threshold: number
  26| |): boolean => {
  27| |  if (!mod) return false;
  28| |  if (route.hasValidation) return false;
  29| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return false;
  31| |  const nodeCount = estimateNodeCount(mod.content);
  32| |  return nodeCount <= threshold;
  33| |};
  35|▼|export const markInline = (
  36| |  route: RouteDef,
  37| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  38| |  threshold: number
  39| |): RouteDef => {
  40| |  const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
  41| |  const shouldInline = isInlineEligible(route, mod, threshold);
  43| |  return shouldInline === route.shouldInline ? route : { ...route, shouldInline };
  44| |};
  46|▼|export const detectInlineCandidates = (
  47| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  48| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  49| |  threshold: number
  50| |): RouteDef[] => routes.map((r) => markInline(r, modules, threshold));
  52|▼|export const hasConstantResponse = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
  53| |  route.isConstantResponse && !!route.constantResponse;
  55|▼|export const groupByConstantResponse = (
  56| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[]
  57| |): Map<string, RouteDef[]> => {
  58| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
  60| |  for (const route of routes) {
  61| |    if (!hasConstantResponse(route)) continue;
  63| |    const key = route.constantResponse!;
  64| |    const existing = groups.get(key);
  66| |    if (existing) existing.push(route);
  67| |    else groups.set(key, [route]);
  68| |  }
  70| |  return groups;
  71| |};
  73|▼|export const buildDedupMap = (
  74| |  groups: Map<string, RouteDef[]>
  75| |): Map<string, string> => {
  76| |  const replacements = new Map<string, string>();
  78| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
  79| |    if (group.length < 2) continue;
  81| |    const leader = group[0]!;
  83| |    for (let i = 1; i < group.length; i++) {
  84| |      replacements.set(group[i]!.handlerRef, leader.handlerRef);
  85| |    }
  86| |  }
  88| |  return replacements;
  89| |};
  91|▼|export const applyDedup = (
  92| |  route: RouteDef,
  93| |  dedupMap: Map<string, string>
  94| |): RouteDef => {
  95| |  const dedupGroup = dedupMap.get(route.handlerRef);
  96| |  return dedupGroup ? { ...route, dedupGroup } : route;
  97| |};
  99|▼|export const deduplicateRoutes = (routes: RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] => {
 100| |  const groups = groupByConstantResponse(routes);
 101| |  const dedupMap = buildDedupMap(groups);
 103| |  if (dedupMap.size === 0) return routes;
 105| |  return routes.map((r) => applyDedup(r, dedupMap));
 106| |};
 108|▼|export const countInlined = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 109| |  routes.filter((r) => r.shouldInline).length;
 111|▼|export const countDeduped = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 112| |  routes.filter((r) => r.dedupGroup).length;
 114|▼|export const runOptimization = (
 115| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 116| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 117| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 118| |  logger: Logger
 119| |): OptimizationResult =>
 120| |  logger.time("optimization", () => {
 121| |    const inlined = detectInlineCandidates(routes, modules, opts.inlineThreshold);
 123| |    const deduped = opts.enableHandlerDeduplication
 124| |      ? deduplicateRoutes(inlined)
 125| |      : inlined;
 127| |    const inlinedCount = countInlined(deduped);
 128| |    const dedupedCount = countDeduped(deduped);
 130| |    logger.info(
 131| |      `Optimized: ${inlinedCount} inlined | ${dedupedCount} deduplicated`
 132| |    );
 134| |    return {
 135| |      routes: deduped,
 136| |      meta: {
 137| |        inlined: inlinedCount,
 138| |        deduplicated: dedupedCount,
 139| |        eliminated: routes.length - deduped.length,
 140| |      },
 141| |    };
 142| |  });
---
