   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Derive & Resolve — Context enrichment pipeline.
   3| | * Composable, type-safe context extensions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { MaybePromise } from "./types";
   9|▼|export type DeriveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  10| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  12|▼|export type ResolveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  13| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  15| |// ============================================================================
  16| |// Derive Pipeline (runs before validation)
  17| |// ============================================================================
  19|▼|export const createDerivePipeline = () => {
  20| |  const fns: DeriveFn[] = [];
  22| |  return {
  23| |    add(fn: DeriveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  25| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  26| |      let current = ctx;
  27| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  28| |        const result = await fn(current);
  29| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  30| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  31| |        }
  32| |      }
  33| |      return current;
  34| |    },
  36| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  37| |  };
  38| |};
  40| |// ============================================================================
  41| |// Resolve Pipeline (runs after validation, before handler)
  42| |// ============================================================================
  44|▼|export const createResolvePipeline = () => {
  45| |  const fns: ResolveFn[] = [];
  47| |  return {
  48| |    add(fn: ResolveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  50| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  51| |      let current = ctx;
  52| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  53| |        const result = await fn(current);
  54| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  55| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  56| |        }
  57| |      }
  58| |      return current;
  59| |    },
  61| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  62| |  };
  63| |};
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Common Derive Factories
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const deriveUser = <T>(extractor: (ctx: FluxContext) => MaybePromise<T | null>) =>
  70| |  async (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ user: await extractor(ctx) });
  72|▼|export const deriveDb = <T>(factory: () => T) =>
  73| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ db: factory() });
  75|▼|export const deriveRequestId = () =>
  76| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ requestId: ctx.requestId });

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Hook Execution Engine v3.0
   3| | * Composable, async middleware with scoped lifecycle.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Types
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13|▼|export type HookResult =
  14| |  | { readonly ok: true; ctx: FluxContext }
  15| |  | { readonly ok: false; response: Response };
  17|▼|export type HookFn = (ctx: FluxContext) => Promise<HookResult> | HookResult;
  19| |// ============================================================================
  20| |// Hook Constructors
  21| |// ============================================================================
  23|▼|export const continueHook = (ctx: FluxContext): HookResult => ({ ok: true, ctx });
  24|▼|export const haltHook = (response: Response): HookResult => ({ ok: false, response });
  26| |// ============================================================================
  27| |// Hook Execution
  28| |// ============================================================================
  30| |export const executeHooks = async (
  31| |  ctx: FluxContext,
  32| |  hooks: readonly HookFn[]
  33| |): Promise<{ ctx: FluxContext; halted?: Response }> => {
  34| |  let current = ctx;
  35| |  for (const hook of hooks) {
  36| |    const result = await hook(current);
  37| |    if (!result.ok) return { ctx: current, halted: result.response };
  38| |    current = result.ctx;
  39| |  }
  40| |  return { ctx: current };
  41| |};
  43| |// ============================================================================
  44| |// Hook Composition
  45| |// ============================================================================
  47|▼|export const composeHooks = (...hooks: HookFn[]): HookFn =>
  48| |  async (ctx) => {
  49| |    const result = await executeHooks(ctx, hooks);
  50| |    if (result.halted) return haltHook(result.halted);
  51| |    return continueHook(result.ctx);
  52| |  };
  54| |// ============================================================================
  55| |// Hook Filtering by Scope
  56| |// ============================================================================
  58|▼|export const filterByScope = (scope: LifeCycleType) =>
  59| |  (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  60| |    hooks.filter(h => !h.scope || h.scope === scope || h.scope === "global");
  62|▼|export const filterGlobal = (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  63| |  hooks.filter(h => h.scope === "global" || h.scope === "scoped");
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Hook Merging (Pure)
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const mergeHookArrays = (
  70| |  a: HookContainer[] | undefined,
  71| |  b: HookContainer[] | undefined
  72| |): HookContainer[] => {
  73| |  if (!a && !b) return [];
  74| |  if (!a) return b!;
  75| |  if (!b) return a;
  77| |  const checksums = new Set(a.map(h => h.checksum).filter(Boolean));
  78| |  const merged = [...a];
  79| |  for (const hook of b) {
  80| |    if (hook.checksum && checksums.has(hook.checksum)) continue;
  81| |    merged.push(hook);
  82| |  }
  83| |  return merged;
  84| |};
  86| |// ============================================================================
  87| |// Async Detection
  88| |// ============================================================================
  90|▼|export const isAsyncFn = (fn: Function): boolean =>
  91| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncFunction" ||
  92| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncGeneratorFunction";
  94| |// ============================================================================
  95| |// Higher-Order Hook Factories
  96| |// ============================================================================
  98|▼|export const withTiming = (name: string, hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
  99| |  async (ctx) => {
 100| |    const start = performance.now();
 101| |    const result = await hook(ctx);
 102| |    ctx.setState(`__timing_${name}`, performance.now() - start);
 103| |    return result;
 104| |  };
 106|▼|export const withErrorBoundary = (fallback: (err: Error) => Response) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 107| |  async (ctx) => {
 108| |    try { return await hook(ctx); }
 109|!|    catch (err) { return haltHook(fallback(err as Error)); }
 110| |  };
 112|▼|export const conditional = (predicate: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 113| |  (ctx) => predicate(ctx) ? hook(ctx) : continueHook(ctx);
---

---
   1| |// ============================================================================
   2| |// FLUX HTTP — Schema-first typed route definitions
   3| |// ============================================================================
   4| |//
   5| |// Breaking change:
   6| |// - The second argument is now a schema object, not a route path.
   7| |// - Route path is inferred from the filename by the compiler.
   8| |//
   9| |// Example:
  10| |//   export default get(async (ctx) => {
  11| |//     return ctx.json({ q: ctx.query.q });
  12| |//   }, {
  13| |//     query: Type.Object({ q: Type.String() }),
  14| |//   });
  15| |// ============================================================================
  17| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
  18| |import type { LazyBody } from "./body";
  19| |import type { MaybePromise, StandardSchemaV1, TSchema } from "./types";
  21|▼|export type SchemaLike = StandardSchemaV1<any, any> | TSchema | object;
  23|▼|export type RouteSchemas = {
  24| |  body?: SchemaLike;
  25| |  query?: SchemaLike;
  26| |  params?: SchemaLike;
  27| |  headers?: SchemaLike;
  28| |  response?: SchemaLike | Record<number, SchemaLike>;
  29| |};
  31|▼|export type BodyRouteSchemas = RouteSchemas;
  32|▼|export type NoBodyRouteSchemas = Omit<RouteSchemas, "body">;
  34|▼|type InferSchema<T> = T extends StandardSchemaV1<any, infer Output>
  35| |  ? Output
  36| |  : T extends { static: infer S }
  37| |    ? S
  38| |    : unknown;
  40|▼|type InferBody<S> = S extends { body: infer X } ? InferSchema<X> : unknown;
  42|▼|type InferQuery<S> = S extends { query: infer X }
  43| |  ? InferSchema<X>
  44| |  : URLSearchParams;
  46|▼|type InferParams<S> = S extends { params: infer X }
  47| |  ? InferSchema<X>
  48| |  : Record<string, string>;
  50|▼|type LooksLikeSchema<T> = T extends StandardSchemaV1<any, any>
  51| |  ? true
  52| |  : T extends { "~standard": unknown }
  53| |    ? true
  54| |    : T extends { static: unknown }
  55| |      ? true
  56| |      : T extends { type: string }
  57| |        ? true
  58| |        : false;
  60|▼|type InferResponse<S> = S extends { response: infer R }
  61| |  ? LooksLikeSchema<R> extends true
  62| |    ? InferSchema<R>
  63| |    : R extends Record<string, infer V>
  64| |      ? InferSchema<V>
  65| |      : unknown
  66| |  : unknown;
  68|▼|type TypedLazyBody<B> = {
  69| |  json<T = B>(): Promise<T>;
  70| |  form<T = B extends Record<string, unknown> ? B : Record<string, string>>(): Promise<T>;
  71| |  multipart<T = B extends Record<string, unknown> ? B : Record<string, unknown>>(): Promise<T>;
  72| |} & LazyBody;
  74|▼|export type RouteContext<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = Omit<
  75| |  FluxContext<InferParams<S>, InferQuery<S>, InferBody<S>>,
  76| |  "body" | "query"
  77| |> & {
  78| |  body: TypedLazyBody<InferBody<S>>;
  79| |  query: InferQuery<S>;
  80| |};
  82|▼|type RouteResult<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = MaybePromise<
  83| |  Response | InferResponse<S>
  84| |>;
  86|▼|export type RouteHandler<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = (
  87| |  ctx: RouteContext<S>,
  88| |) => RouteResult<S>;
  90| |/**
  91| | * Backward-compatible handler type.
  92| | */
  93|▼|export type Handler<
  94| |  B = unknown,
  95| |  Q = URLSearchParams,
  96| |  P = Record<string, string>,
  97| |> = (ctx: FluxContext<P, Q, B>) => MaybePromise<unknown>;
  99|▼|type AnyFunction = (...args: any[]) => any;
 101|▼|const attachSchema = <T extends AnyFunction>(fn: T, schemaOrPath?: unknown): T => {
 102| |  // Runtime compatibility: if an old path string is passed, ignore it.
 103| |  if (schemaOrPath == null || typeof schemaOrPath === "string") {
 104| |    return fn;
 105| |  }
 107| |  Object.defineProperty(fn, "schema", {
 108| |    value: schemaOrPath,
 109| |    enumerable: false,
 110| |    writable: false,
 111| |    configurable: true,
 112| |  });
 114| |  return fn;
 115| |};
 117| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 118|▼|export function get<const S extends NoBodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 119| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 120| |  schema?: S,
 121| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 122| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 123| |}
 125| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 126|▼|export function post<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 127| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 128| |  schema?: S,
 129| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 130| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 131| |}
 133| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 134|▼|export function put<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 135| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 136| |  schema?: S,
 137| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 138| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 139| |}
 141| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 142|▼|export function patch<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 143| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 144| |  schema?: S,
 145| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 146| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 147| |}
 149| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 150|▼|export function del<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 151| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 152| |  schema?: S,
 153| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 154| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 155| |}
 157| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 158|▼|export function all<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 159| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 160| |  schema?: S,
 161| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 162| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);

>src/core/macro.ts
l:./context|./types

f:createMacroRegistry()
t:MacroContext
t:MacroFn
t:MacroDefinition
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Macro System
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - afterHandle can return Response
   6| | * - afterHandle hooks are placed in afterHandle lifecycle
   7| | */
   9| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
  10| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer } from "./types";
  12|▼|export interface MacroContext {
  13| |  onRequest?: (ctx: FluxContext) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  14| |  beforeHandle?: (ctx: FluxContext) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  15| |  afterHandle?: (
  16| |    ctx: FluxContext,
  17| |    response: Response
  18| |  ) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  19| |  afterResponse?: (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => void | Promise<void>;
  20| |}
  22|▼|export type MacroFn = (value: unknown, ctx: MacroContext) => void;
  24|▼|export interface MacroDefinition {
  25| |  name: string;
  26| |  fn: MacroFn;
  27| |}
  29|▼|export const createMacroRegistry = () => {
  30| |  const macros = new Map<string, MacroFn>();
  32| |  return {
  33| |    register(name: string, fn: MacroFn) {
  34| |      macros.set(name, fn);
  35| |      return this;
  36| |    },
  38| |    apply(
  39| |      routeConfig: Record<string, unknown>,
  40| |      lifecycle: LifeCycleStore
  41| |    ): LifeCycleStore {
  42| |      const macroCtx: MacroContext = {};
  44| |      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(routeConfig)) {
  45| |        const macro = macros.get(key);
  46| |        if (macro && value !== undefined) {
  47| |          macro(value, macroCtx);
  48| |        }
  49| |      }
  51| |      const requestHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  52| |      const beforeHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  53| |      const afterHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  55| |      if (macroCtx.onRequest) {
  56| |        requestHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.onRequest, scope: "local" });
  57| |      }
  59| |      if (macroCtx.beforeHandle) {
  60| |        beforeHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.beforeHandle, scope: "local" });
  61| |      }
  63| |      if (macroCtx.afterHandle) {
  64| |        afterHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.afterHandle, scope: "local" });
  65| |      }
  67| |      return {
  68| |        ...lifecycle,
  69| |        request: [...lifecycle.request, ...requestHooks],
  70| |        beforeHandle: [...lifecycle.beforeHandle, ...beforeHooks],
  71| |        afterHandle: [...lifecycle.afterHandle, ...afterHooks],
  72| |      };
  73| |    },
  75| |    has(name: string): boolean {
  76| |      return macros.has(name);
  77| |    },
  79| |    get size(): number {
  80| |      return macros.size;
  81| |    },
  82| |  };
  83| |};
  85| |export const authMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  86| |  name: "auth",
  87| |  fn(value, ctx) {
  88| |    if (value === true) {
  89| |      ctx.beforeHandle = (c: FluxContext) => {
  90| |        if (!c.headers.get("authorization")) {
  91| |          return Response.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  92| |        }
  93| |      };
  94| |    }
  95| |  },
  96| |};
  98| |export const cacheMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  99| |  name: "cache",
 100| |  fn(value, ctx) {
 101| |    if (typeof value === "number") {
 102| |      ctx.afterHandle = (_c: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
 103| |        const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 104| |        headers.set("cache-control", `public, max-age=${value}`);
 106| |        return new Response(response.body, {
 107| |          status: response.status,
 108| |          statusText: response.statusText,
 109| |          headers,
 110| |        });
 111| |      };
 112| |    }
 113| |  },
 114| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview WebSocket support with typed messages and topics.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { ServerWebSocket, WebSocketHandler } from "./types";
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   8|▼|export class FluxWS<Context = unknown, Body = unknown, Response = unknown> {
   9| |  constructor(
  10| |    public raw: ServerWebSocket<any>,
  11| |    public data: Context,
  12| |    public body: Body
  13| |  ) {}
  15| |  send(data: Response | string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array, compress?: boolean): number {
  16| |    if (typeof data === "object" && !(data instanceof ArrayBuffer) && !(data instanceof Uint8Array)) {
  17| |      return this.raw.send(JSON.stringify(data), compress);
  18| |    }
  19| |    return this.raw.send(data as any, compress);
  20| |  }
  22| |  sendText(data: string, compress?: boolean): number { return this.raw.sendText(data, compress); }
  23| |  sendBinary(data: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array, compress?: boolean): number { return this.raw.sendBinary(data, compress); }
  24| |  close(code?: number, reason?: string): void { this.raw.close(code, reason); }
  25| |  terminate(): void { this.raw.terminate(); }
  26| |  ping(data?: string | ArrayBuffer): number { return this.raw.ping(data); }
  27| |  pong(data?: string | ArrayBuffer): number { return this.raw.pong(data); }
  29| |  publish(topic: string, data: Response | string | ArrayBuffer, compress?: boolean): number {
  30| |    if (typeof data === "object" && !(data instanceof ArrayBuffer)) {
  31| |      return this.raw.publish(topic, JSON.stringify(data), compress);
  32| |    }
  33| |    return this.raw.publish(topic, data as any, compress);
  34| |  }
  36| |  subscribe(topic: string): void { this.raw.subscribe(topic); }
  37| |  unsubscribe(topic: string): void { this.raw.unsubscribe(topic); }
  38| |  isSubscribed(topic: string): boolean { return this.raw.isSubscribed(topic); }
  39| |  cork<T>(cb: (ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>) => T): T { return this.raw.cork(() => cb(this)); }
  41| |  get remoteAddress(): string { return this.raw.remoteAddress; }
  42| |  get readyState(): number { return this.raw.readyState; }
  43| |  get subscriptions(): string[] { return this.raw.subscriptions; }
  44| |}
  46|▼|export interface WSLocalHook<Context = unknown, Body = unknown, Response = unknown> {
  47| |  open?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>): void | Promise<void>;
  48| |  message?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>, message: Body): void | Promise<void>;
  49| |  drain?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>): void | Promise<void>;
  50| |  close?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>, code: number, reason: string): void | Promise<void>;
  51| |  upgrade?: Record<string, unknown> | ((ctx: FluxContext) => unknown);
  52| |  body?: any;
  53| |  response?: any;
  54| |}
  56|▼|export const createWSHandler = <Context, Body, Response>(
  57| |  hook: WSLocalHook<Context, Body, Response>
  58| |): WebSocketHandler<Context> => ({
  59| |  open(ws) {
  60| |    hook.open?.(new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body));
  61| |  },
  63| |  message(ws, message) {
  64| |    let parsed: unknown = message;
  66| |    if (typeof message === "string") {
  67| |      try {
  68| |        parsed = JSON.parse(message);
  69| |      } catch {
  70| |        // keep as string
  71| |      }
  72| |    }
  74| |    hook.message?.(
  75| |      new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, parsed as Body),
  76| |      parsed as Body
  77| |    );
  78| |  },
  80| |  drain(ws) {
  81| |    hook.drain?.(new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body));
  82| |  },
  84| |  close(ws, code, reason) {
  85| |    hook.close?.(
  86| |      new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body),
  87| |      code,
  88| |      reason
  89| |    );
  90| |  },
  91| |});

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 2: ANALYSIS — AST-based, zero regex.
   3| | * Detects ctx usage at build time. Produces RouteDefs from discovered modules.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  RouteDef,
   8| |  ModuleInfo,
   9| |  CompilerOptions,
  10| |  HttpMethod,
  11| |  DiscoveryResult,
  12| |  AnalysisResult,
  13| |  HookDef,
  14| |  ContextUsage,
  15| |  RouteCacheConfig,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import { HTTP_METHODS, FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE } from "../types";
  19| |import { parseRouteFilename } from "./discovery";
  20| |import { computeSignatureHash } from "../utils/hash";
  21| |import {
  22| |  parseModule,
  23| |  isPureBodyAST,
  24| |  inferResponseTypeAST,
  25| |} from "../utils/ast";
  26| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  28| |// ============================================================================
  29| |// Pure Route Analysis Functions
  30| |// ============================================================================
  32|▼|export const parseRouteFile = (file: string) => parseRouteFilename(file);
  34|▼|export const findModuleByPath = (
  35| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  36| |): ModuleInfo | undefined => modules.find((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  38|▼|export const findModuleIndex = (
  39| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  40| |): number => modules.findIndex((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  42| |// ============================================================================
  43| |// Constant Response Detection
  44| |// ============================================================================
  46|▼|const evaluateConstantBody = (body: string): string | null => {
  47| |  const expr = body
  48| |    .replace(/^return\s+/, "")
  49| |    .replace(/;\s*$/, "")
  50| |    .trim();
  52| |  if (!expr) return null;
  54| |  try {
  55| |    // Only called after isPureBodyAST() has approved the body.
  56| |    const fn = new Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`);
  57| |    const value = fn();
  58| |    return JSON.stringify(value);
  59| |  } catch {
  60| |    return null;
  61| |  }
  62| |};
  64| |export const detectConstantResponse = (
  65| |  mod: ModuleInfo
  66| |): { isConstant: boolean; constantResponse?: string } => {
  67| |  const parsed = parseModule(mod.content);
  69| |  if (!parsed.handler) {
  70| |    return { isConstant: false };
  71| |  }
  73| |  if (!isPureBodyAST(parsed.ast)) {
  74| |    return { isConstant: false };
  75| |  }
  77| |  const json = evaluateConstantBody(parsed.handler.body);
  79| |  if (!json) {
  80| |    return { isConstant: false };
  81| |  }
  83| |  return {
  84| |    isConstant: true,
  85| |    constantResponse: json,
  86| |  };
  87| |};
  89| |// ============================================================================
  90| |// RouteDef Factory — Pure
  91| |// ============================================================================
  93|▼|export const buildHandlerRef = (routeIndex: number): string => `_h${routeIndex}`;
  94|▼|export const buildSchemaRef = (routeIndex: number, hasSchema: boolean): string | null =>
  95| |  hasSchema ? `_s${routeIndex}` : null;
  96|▼|export const computeMethodIndex = (method: HttpMethod): number =>
  97| |  HTTP_METHODS.indexOf(method);
  99|▼|export const findHandlerSymbol = (mod: ModuleInfo) =>
 100| |  mod.symbols.find((s) => s.name === "default") || mod.symbols[0];
 101| |/**
 102| | * Normalize exported route cache config.
 103| | *
 104| | * Pure and exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe.
 105| | */
 106|▼|const normalizeRouteCache = (
 107| |  input: unknown,
 108| |): RouteCacheConfig | undefined => {
 109| |  if (typeof input === "number") {
 110| |    return { maxAge: input };
 111| |  }
 113| |  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
 114| |    return undefined;
 115| |  }
 117| |  const cfg = input as Record<string, unknown>;
 119| |  const cache: {
 120| |    maxAge?: number;
 121| |    swr?: number;
 122| |    immutable?: boolean;
 123| |    vary?: string[];
 124| |  } = {};
 126| |  if (typeof cfg.maxAge === "number") cache.maxAge = cfg.maxAge;
 127| |  if (typeof cfg.swr === "number") cache.swr = cfg.swr;
 128| |  if (typeof cfg.immutable === "boolean") cache.immutable = cfg.immutable;
 130| |  if (Array.isArray(cfg.vary)) {
 131| |    cache.vary = cfg.vary.filter(
 132| |      (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
 133| |    );
 134| |  }
 136| |  return Object.keys(cache).length > 0 ? cache : undefined;
 137| |};
 140|▼|export const createRouteDef = (
 141| |  file: string,
 142| |  parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>>,
 143| |  mod: ModuleInfo,
 144| |  routeIndex: number,
 145| |  moduleIdx: number,
 146| |): RouteDef => {
 147| |  const handlerSym = findHandlerSymbol(mod);
 148| |  const methodIdx = computeMethodIndex(parsed.method);
 150| |  const astParsed = parseModule(mod.content);
 152| |  const cache = normalizeRouteCache(astParsed.config?.cache);
 153| |  const usage = astParsed.handler?.usage ?? FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE;
 155| |  const isAsync =
 156| |    astParsed.handler?.isAsync ?? handlerSym?.isAsync ?? false;
 158| |  const hooks = Array.isArray(astParsed.config?.hooks)
 159| |    ? astParsed.config.hooks.filter(
 160| |        (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string",
 161| |      )
 162| |    : [];
 164| |  const { isConstant, constantResponse } = detectConstantResponse(mod);
 165| |  const inferredResponseType = inferResponseTypeAST(astParsed.ast);
 167| |  const responseType = usage.json
 168| |    ? "json"
 169| |    : usage.text
 170| |      ? "text"
 171| |      : usage.html
 172| |        ? "html"
 173| |        : usage.stream
 174| |          ? "stream"
 175| |          : inferredResponseType;
 177| |  return {
 178| |    ...parsed,
 179| |    file,
 180| |    moduleIdx,
 181| |    handlerRef: buildHandlerRef(routeIndex),
 182| |    schemaRef: buildSchemaRef(routeIndex, !!mod.schemaExport),
 183| |    signatureHash: computeSignatureHash(methodIdx, parsed.path),
 184| |    handlerSize: handlerSym?.size || 9999,
 185| |    isAsync,
 186| |    shouldInline: false,
 187| |    responseType,
 188| |    hasValidation: !!mod.schemaExport,
 189| |    hotnessScore: 0,
 190| |    hooks,
 191| |    isConstantResponse: isConstant,
 192| |    usage,
 194| |    ...(constantResponse !== undefined ? { constantResponse } : {}),
 195| |    ...(cache !== undefined ? { cache } : {}),
 196| |    ...(astParsed.config !== undefined ? { config: astParsed.config } : {}),
 197| |  };
 198| |};
 200| |export const resolveRouteModule = (
 201| |  file: string,
 202| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 203| |): { mod: ModuleInfo; parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>> } | null => {
 204| |  const parsed = parseRouteFile(file);
 205| |  if (!parsed) return null;
 206| |  const mod = findModuleByPath(modules, file);
 207| |  if (!mod) return null;
 208| |  if (!mod.hasDefaultExport) return null;
 209| |  return { mod, parsed };
 210| |};
 212| |// ============================================================================
 213| |// Route Graph Builder — Pure
 214| |// ============================================================================
 216|▼|export const buildRouteGraph = (
 217| |  files: readonly string[],
 218| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 219| |): RouteDef[] => {
 220| |  const routes: RouteDef[] = [];
 222| |  for (const file of files) {
 223| |    const resolved = resolveRouteModule(file, modules);
 224| |    if (!resolved) continue;
 226| |    const moduleIdx = findModuleIndex(modules, file);
 227| |    if (moduleIdx < 0) continue;
 229| |    routes.push(
 230| |      createRouteDef(
 231| |        file,
 232| |        resolved.parsed,
 233| |        resolved.mod,
 234| |        routes.length,
 235| |        moduleIdx
 236| |      )
 237| |    );
 238| |  }
 240| |  return routes;
 241| |};
 242| |// ============================================================================
 243| |// Dead Route Detection — Pure
 244| |// ============================================================================
 246|▼|export const staticRouteKey = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 247| |  `${route.method}:${route.path}`;
 249| |export const detectDeadRoutes = (
 250| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 251| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 252| |): { alive: RouteDef[]; dead: RouteDef[] } => {
 253| |  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
 254| |  const alive: RouteDef[] = [];
 255| |  const dead: RouteDef[] = [];
 257| |  for (const route of routes) {
 258| |    const hasValidModule = route.moduleIdx >= 0 && route.moduleIdx < modules.length;
 259| |    if (!hasValidModule) {
 260| |      dead.push(route);
 261| |      continue;
 262| |    }
 263| |    if (route.isStatic && seen.has(staticRouteKey(route))) {
 264| |      dead.push(route);
 265| |      continue;
 266| |    }
 267| |    if (route.isStatic) {
 268| |      seen.set(staticRouteKey(route), alive.length);
 269| |    }
 270| |    alive.push(route);
 271| |  }
 272| |  return { alive, dead };
 273| |};
 275| |// ============================================================================
 276| |// Hook Resolution — Pure
 277| |// ============================================================================
 279|▼|export const collectHookNames = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): Set<string> => {
 280| |  const referenced = new Set<string>();
 281| |  for (const route of routes) {
 282| |    for (const hook of route.hooks) referenced.add(hook);
 283| |  }
 284| |  return referenced;
 285| |};
 287|▼|export const createHookDef = (name: string, hooksDir: string): HookDef => ({
 288| |  name,
 289| |  source: `${hooksDir}/${name}.ts`,
 290| |  moduleIdx: -1,
 291| |  isAsync: true,
 292| |});
 294|▼|export const resolveHooks = (
 295| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 296| |  hooksDir: string | undefined
 297| |): ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef> => {
 298| |  const names = collectHookNames(routes);
 299| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookDef>();
 300| |  if (!hooksDir || names.size === 0) return hooks;
 301| |  for (const name of names) {
 302| |    hooks.set(name, createHookDef(name, hooksDir));
 303| |  }
 304| |  return hooks;
 305| |};
 307| |// ============================================================================
 308| |// Statistics — Pure
 309| |// ============================================================================
 311|▼|export const countRoutes = (
 312| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 313| |  predicate: (r: RouteDef) => boolean
 314| |): number => routes.filter(predicate).length;
 316|▼|export const countStatic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 317| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isStatic);
 318|▼|export const countDynamic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 319| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isDynamic);
 320|▼|export const countConstant = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 321| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isConstantResponse);
 323| |// ============================================================================
 324| |// Phase Orchestrator — Composed from pure functions
 325| |// ============================================================================
 327|▼|export const runAnalysis = (
 328| |  discovery: DiscoveryResult,
 329| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 330| |  logger: Logger
 331| |): AnalysisResult =>
 332| |  logger.time("analysis", () => {
 333| |    const routes = buildRouteGraph(discovery.files, discovery.modules);
 334| |    const { alive, dead } = detectDeadRoutes(routes, discovery.modules);
 336| |    if (dead.length > 0) {
 337| |      logger.warn(`Eliminated ${dead.length} dead route(s)`, {
 338| |        dead: dead.map((r) => `${r.method} ${r.path}`),
 339| |      });
 340| |    }
 342| |    const hooks = resolveHooks(alive, opts.hooksDir);
 344| |    const needsBody = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.body).length;
 345| |    const needsFile = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.file).length;
 346| |    const needsQuery = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.query).length;
 348| |    logger.info(
 349| |      `Routes: ${alive.length} total (${countStatic(alive)} static, ${countDynamic(alive)} dynamic, ${countConstant(alive)} constant)`
 350| |    );
 351| |    logger.info(
 352| |      `Usage analysis: ${needsBody} need body | ${needsFile} need files | ${needsQuery} need query`
 353| |    );
 355| |    if (hooks.size > 0) {
 356| |      logger.info(`Hooks resolved: ${[...hooks.keys()].join(", ")}`);
 357| |    }
 359| |    return { routes: alive, modules: discovery.modules, hooks };
 360| |  });

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Guard — Scoped hook application.
   3| | * Apply hooks to a group of routes with proper scoping.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   7| |import { EMPTY_LIFECYCLE } from "./types";
   8| |import { mergeHookArrays } from "./hooks";
  10|▼|export interface GuardOptions {
  11| |  scope?: LifeCycleType;
  12| |  beforeHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  13| |  afterHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  14| |  transform?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  15| |  error?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  16| |  onRequest?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const createGuard = (options: GuardOptions = {}) => {
  20| |  const scope = options.scope ?? "scoped";
  22|▼|  const toContainers = (hooks: HookContainer | HookContainer[] | undefined): HookContainer[] => {
  23| |    if (!hooks) return [];
  24| |    const arr = Array.isArray(hooks) ? hooks : [hooks];
  25| |    return arr.map(h => ({ ...h, scope: h.scope ?? scope }));
  26| |  };
  28| |  const guardHooks: Partial<LifeCycleStore> = {
  29| |    beforeHandle: toContainers(options.beforeHandle),
  30| |    afterHandle: toContainers(options.afterHandle),
  31| |    transform: toContainers(options.transform),
  32| |    error: toContainers(options.error),
  33| |    request: toContainers(options.onRequest),
  34| |  };
  36| |  return {
  37| |    scope,
  38| |    hooks: guardHooks,
  40| |    applyTo(lifecycle: LifeCycleStore): LifeCycleStore {
  41| |      return {
  42| |        ...lifecycle,
  43| |        beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.beforeHandle, guardHooks.beforeHandle),
  44| |        afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.afterHandle, guardHooks.afterHandle),
  45| |        transform: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.transform, guardHooks.transform),
  46| |        error: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.error, guardHooks.error),
  47| |        request: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.request, guardHooks.request),
  48| |      };
  49| |    },
  50| |  };
  51| |};
  53|▼|export const mergeLifeCycle = (a: LifeCycleStore, b: Partial<LifeCycleStore>): LifeCycleStore => ({
  54| |  start: mergeHookArrays(a.start, b.start),
  55| |  request: mergeHookArrays(a.request, b.request),
  56| |  parse: mergeHookArrays(a.parse, b.parse),
  57| |  transform: mergeHookArrays(a.transform, b.transform),
  58| |  beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.beforeHandle, b.beforeHandle),
  59| |  afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.afterHandle, b.afterHandle),
  60| |  mapResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.mapResponse, b.mapResponse),
  61| |  afterResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.afterResponse, b.afterResponse),
  62| |  trace: mergeHookArrays(a.trace, b.trace),
  63| |  error: mergeHookArrays(a.error, b.error),
  64| |  stop: mergeHookArrays(a.stop, b.stop),
  65| |});

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Plugin Architecture v3.0
   3| | * Lifecycle hooks, extensibility, composable plugins.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookFn } from "./hooks";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Plugin Interface
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13|▼|export interface FluxPlugin {
  14| |  readonly name: string;
  15| |  readonly version?: string;
  17| |  // Lifecycle
  18| |  init?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  19| |  close?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  21| |  // Request lifecycle
  22| |  onRequest?(ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<FluxContext | Response>;
  23| |  onResponse?(ctx: FluxContext, response: Response): MaybePromise<Response>;
  24| |  onError?(error: Error, ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<Response | void>;
  25| |}
  27|▼|type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
  29| |// ============================================================================
  30| |// Plugin Registry
  31| |// ============================================================================
  33|▼|export interface PluginContext {
  34| |  plugins: FluxPlugin[];
  35| |  hooks: Map<string, HookFn[]>;
  36| |  addHook(name: string, hook: HookFn): void;
  37| |  getHooks(name: string): readonly HookFn[];
  38| |  register(plugin: FluxPlugin): void;
  39| |  initAll(): Promise<void>;
  40| |  closeAll(): Promise<void>;
  41| |}
  43|▼|export const createPluginContext = (): PluginContext => {
  44| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookFn[]>();
  45| |  const plugins: FluxPlugin[] = [];
  47| |  return {
  48| |    plugins,
  49| |    hooks,
  50| |    addHook(name, hook) {
  51| |      const existing = hooks.get(name) ?? [];
  52| |      existing.push(hook);
  53| |      hooks.set(name, existing);
  54| |    },
  55| |    getHooks(name) { return hooks.get(name) ?? []; },
  56| |    register(plugin) { plugins.push(plugin); },
  57| |    async initAll() {
  58| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.();
  59| |    },
  60| |    async closeAll() {
  61| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.close?.();
  62| |    },
  63| |  };
  64| |};
  66| |// ============================================================================
  67| |// Plugin Composition
  68| |// ============================================================================
  70|▼|export const composePlugins = (...plugins: FluxPlugin[]): FluxPlugin => ({
  71| |  name: plugins.map(p => p.name).join("+"),
  72| |  async init() { for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.(); },
  73| |  async close() { for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) await p.close?.(); },
  74| |  async onRequest(ctx) {
  75| |    let current = ctx;
  76| |    for (const p of plugins) {
  77| |      const result = await p.onRequest?.(current);
  78| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
  79| |      if (result) current = result;
  80| |    }
  81| |    return current;
  82| |  },
  83| |  async onResponse(ctx, response) {
  84| |    let current = response;
  85| |    for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) {
  86| |      current = await p.onResponse?.(ctx, current) ?? current;
  87| |    }
  88| |    return current;
  89| |  },
  90| |  async onError(error, ctx) {
  91| |    for (const p of plugins) {
  92| |      const result = await p.onError?.(error, ctx);
  93| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
  94| |    }
  95| |  },
  96| |});

   1| |/**

  35|▼|export const mergeOptions = (

  37|→|): CompilerOptions => defu(opts, DEFAULT_OPTS) as CompilerOptions;
  39|▼|export const createCompilationResult = (
  40| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
  41| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,

  44| |  staticRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isStatic),
  45| |  dynamicRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isDynamic),
  46| |  modules: analysis.modules,
  47| |  meta: {

  49| |    deduplicatedHandlers: optimized.meta.deduplicated,
  50| |    eliminatedRoutes: optimized.meta.eliminated,
  51| |    totalCompileTime: elapsedMs,
  52| |  },

  55|▼|export const runDiscoveryPhase = (
  56| |  opts: CompilerOptions,

  59| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
  60| |    const result = runDiscovery(opts, logger);
  62| |    logger.info("discovery complete", {
  63| |      files: result.files.length,
  64| |      modules: result.modules.length,

 119| |      opts,
 120| |      logger
 121| |    );

 124| |      lines: code.split("\n").length,
 125| |    });
 127| |    return code;
 128| |  });
 130|▼|export const runLinkingPhase = (
 131| |  code: string,
 132| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 133| |  logger: Logger
 134| |): string =>
 135| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
 136| |    return runLinker(code, opts, logger);
 137| |  });
 139|▼|export class FluxCompiler {
 140| |  constructor(private readonly input: Partial<CompilerOptions> = {}) {}
 142| |  compile(): CompiledRoute {
 143| |    const validated = validateOptions(this.input);
 145| |    if (!validated.ok) {
 146|!|      throw new Error(
 147| |        `Compiler options invalid:\n${validated.error.join("\n")}`
 148| |      );
 149| |    }
 151| |    const opts = validated.value;
 152| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 153| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 155| |    if (opts.precompileValidators || opts.precompileSerializers) {
 156| |      logger.warn(
 157| |        "compile() is synchronous. Use buildAsync() to enable validator/serializer precompilation."
 158| |      );
 159| |    }
 161| |    logger.info("flux compiler started", {
 162| |      target: opts.target,
 163| |      optimizationLevel: opts.optimizationLevel,
 164| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 165| |      outDir: opts.outDir,
 166| |    });
 168| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(opts, logger);
 169| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, opts, logger);
 170| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, opts, logger);
 172| |    writeArtifacts(optimized.routes, opts, logger);
 174| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(optimized, analysis, opts, logger);
 175| |    const outPath = runLinkingPhase(code, opts, logger);
 177| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 179| |    logger.info("build complete", {
 180| |      elapsedMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)),
 181| |      outPath,
 182| |    });
 184| |    return createCompilationResult(optimized, analysis, elapsed);
 185| |  }
 187| |  async compileAsync(): Promise<CompiledRoute> {
 188| |    const validated = validateOptions(this.input);
 190| |    if (!validated.ok) {
 191|!|      throw new Error(
 192| |        `Compiler options invalid:\n${validated.error.join("\n")}`
 193| |      );
 194| |    }
 196| |    const opts = validated.value;
 197| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 198| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 200| |    logger.info("flux compiler started (async)", {
 201| |      target: opts.target,
 202| |      optimizationLevel: opts.optimizationLevel,
 203| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 204| |      outDir: opts.outDir,
 205| |    });
 207| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(opts, logger);
 208| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, opts, logger);
 209| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, opts, logger);
 211| |    let routes = optimized.routes;
 213| |    routes = await precompileValidators(
 214| |      routes,
 215| |      analysis.modules,
 216| |      opts,
 217| |      logger
 218| |    );
 220| |    routes = await precompileSerializers(
 221| |      routes,
 222| |      analysis.modules,
 223| |      opts,
 224| |      logger
 225| |    );
 227| |    const enriched: OptimizationResult = {
 228| |      routes,
 229| |      meta: optimized.meta,
 230| |    };
 232| |    writeArtifacts(enriched.routes, opts, logger);
 234| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(enriched, analysis, opts, logger);
 235| |    const outPath = runLinkingPhase(code, opts, logger);
 237| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 239| |    logger.info("build complete", {
 240| |      elapsedMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)),
 241| |      outPath,
 242| |    });
 244| |    return createCompilationResult(enriched, analysis, elapsed);
 245| |  }
 246| |}
 248|▼|export function build(opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>): CompiledRoute {
 249| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compile();
 250| |}
 252|▼|export async function buildAsync(
 253| |  opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>
 254| |): Promise<CompiledRoute> {
 255| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compileAsync();
 256| |}
 258| |if (import.meta.main) {
 259| |  await buildAsync();
 260| |}

>src/core/plugins/compression.ts
l:../plugin
e:CompressionOptions|compression
f:shouldCompress(ct: string):boolean
f:compression(options: CompressionOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
t:CompressionOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Compression plugin.
   3| | *
   4| | * Hardened:
   5| | * - guards against missing CompressionStream
   6| | */
   8| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
  10|▼|export interface CompressionOptions {
  11| |  threshold?: number;
  12| |  filter?: (contentType: string) => boolean;
  13| |}
  15| |const COMPRESSIBLE = new Set([
  16| |  "text/",
  17| |  "application/json",
  18| |  "application/javascript",
  19| |  "application/xml",
  20| |  "image/svg+xml",
  21| |]);
  23|▼|const shouldCompress = (ct: string): boolean => {
  24| |  for (const prefix of COMPRESSIBLE) {
  25| |    if (ct.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
  26| |  }
  28| |  return false;
  29| |};
  31|▼|export const compression = (options: CompressionOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  32| |  const { threshold = 1024, filter = shouldCompress } = options;
  34| |  return {
  35| |    name: "compression",
  37| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  38| |      if (!response.body) return response;
  39| |      if (response.headers.get("content-encoding")) return response;
  41| |      const ct = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  42| |      if (!filter(ct)) return response;
  44| |      const len = Number(response.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
  45| |      if (len && len < threshold) return response;
  47| |      const acceptEncoding = ctx.headers.get("accept-encoding") || "";
  49| |      const encoding = acceptEncoding.includes("gzip")
  50| |        ? "gzip"
  51| |        : acceptEncoding.includes("deflate")
  52| |          ? "deflate"
  53| |          : null;
  55| |      if (!encoding) return response;
  57| |      if (typeof CompressionStream === "undefined") {
  58| |        return response;
  59| |      }
  61| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  62| |      headers.set("content-encoding", encoding);
  63| |      headers.delete("content-length");
  65| |      const compressed = response.body.pipeThrough(new CompressionStream(encoding));
  67| |      return new Response(compressed, {
  68| |        status: response.status,
  69| |        statusText: response.statusText,
  70| |        headers,
  71| |      });
  72| |    },
  73| |  };
  74| |};
---

>src/core/plugins/cors.ts
l:../plugin|../context
e:CorsOptions|cors
f:cors(options: CorsOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext):boolean
f:appendVary(headers: Headers, value: string):void
f:setCorsHeaders(ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers):void
t:CorsOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * CORS plugin.
   3| | *
   4| | * Hardened:
   5| | * - always varies on Origin
   6| | * - safer credentials handling
   7| | */
   9| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
  10| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
  12|▼|export interface CorsOptions {
  13| |  origin?: string | string[] | ((origin: string, ctx: FluxContext) => boolean);
  14| |  methods?: string[];
  15| |  allowedHeaders?: string[];
  16| |  exposedHeaders?: string[];
  17| |  credentials?: boolean;
  18| |  maxAge?: number;
  19| |  preflightContinue?: boolean;
  20| |}
  22| |const DEFAULT_METHODS = ["GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "PATCH", "POST", "DELETE"];
  24|▼|export const cors = (options: CorsOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  25| |  const {
  26| |    origin = "*",
  27| |    methods = DEFAULT_METHODS,
  28| |    allowedHeaders,
  29| |    exposedHeaders,
  30| |    credentials = false,
  31| |    maxAge = 86400,
  32| |    preflightContinue = false,
  33| |  } = options;
  35|▼|  const isOriginAllowed = (requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext): boolean => {
  36| |    if (origin === "*") return true;
  37| |    if (typeof origin === "string") return origin === requestOrigin;
  38| |    if (Array.isArray(origin)) return origin.includes(requestOrigin);
  39| |    return origin(requestOrigin, ctx);
  40| |  };
  42|▼|  const appendVary = (headers: Headers, value: string): void => {
  43| |    const existing = headers.get("vary");
  44| |    if (!existing) {
  45| |      headers.set("vary", value);
  46| |      return;
  47| |    }
  49| |    const parts = existing.split(",").map((x) => x.trim().toLowerCase());
  50| |    if (!parts.includes(value.toLowerCase())) {
  51| |      headers.set("vary", `${existing}, ${value}`);
  52| |    }
  53| |  };
  55|▼|  const setCorsHeaders = (ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers): void => {
  56| |    appendVary(headers, "Origin");
  58| |    const requestOrigin = ctx.headers.get("origin") || "";
  59| |    if (!requestOrigin) return;
  61| |    if (isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin, ctx)) {
  62| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", requestOrigin);
  63| |    } else if (origin === "*" && !credentials) {
  64| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  65| |    }
  67| |    if (credentials) {
  68| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true");
  69| |    }
  71| |    if (exposedHeaders?.length) {
  72| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", exposedHeaders.join(", "));
  73| |    }
  74| |  };
  76| |  return {
  77| |    name: "cors",
  79| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  80| |      if (!ctx.headers.get("origin")) return ctx;
  82| |      if (ctx.method === "OPTIONS") {
  83| |        const headers = new Headers();
  85| |        setCorsHeaders(ctx, headers);
  86| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", methods.join(", "));
  88| |        if (allowedHeaders?.length) {
  89| |          headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", allowedHeaders.join(", "));
  90| |        } else {
  91| |          const reqHeaders = ctx.headers.get("access-control-request-headers");
  92| |          if (reqHeaders) {
  93| |            headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", reqHeaders);
  94| |          }
  95| |        }
  97| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Max-Age", String(maxAge));
  99| |        if (preflightContinue) return ctx;
 101| |        return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
 102| |      }
 104| |      return ctx;
 105| |    },
 107| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
 108| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 109| |      setCorsHeaders(ctx, headers);
 111| |      return new Response(response.body, {
 112| |        status: response.status,
 113| |        statusText: response.statusText,
 114| |        headers,
 115| |      });
 116| |    },
 117| |  };
 118| |};
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * Logger plugin.
   3| | *
   4| | * Hardened:
   5| | * - redacts sensitive headers
   6| | * - exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe pino options
   7| | */
   8| |import pino, { type Logger as PinoLogger } from "pino";
   9| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
  10| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
  12|▼|export interface LoggerOptions {
  13| |  level?: string;
  14| |  logger?: PinoLogger;
  15| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  16| |}
  18| |const REDACT_PATHS = [
  19| |  "req.headers.authorization",
  20| |  "req.headers.cookie",
  21| |  "headers.authorization",
  22| |  "headers.cookie",
  23| |] as const;
  25| |/**
  26| | * Create a pino logger with safe defaults.
  27| | */
  28|▼|const createPinoLogger = (options: LoggerOptions): PinoLogger => {
  29| |  if (options.logger) return options.logger;
  31|→|  return pino({
  32| |    level: options.level ?? "info",
  33| |    base: null,
  34| |    redact: [...REDACT_PATHS],
  35| |  });
  36| |};
  38| |/**
  39| | * Build structured access-log payload.
  40| | */
  41|▼|const createLogPayload = (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
  42| |  const duration = performance.now() - ctx.startTime;
  44| |  return {
  45| |    requestId: ctx.requestId,
  46| |    method: ctx.method,
  47| |    path: ctx.path,
  48| |    status: response.status,
  49| |    durationMs: Math.round(duration * 1000) / 1000,
  50| |    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  51| |  };
  52| |};
  54|▼|export const logger = (options: LoggerOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  55| |  const log = createPinoLogger(options);
  57| |  return {
  58| |    name: "logger",
  60| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  61| |      if (options.skip?.(ctx)) return response;
  63| |      const payload = createLogPayload(ctx, response);
  65| |      if (response.status >= 500) {
  66| |        log.error(payload);
  67| |      } else if (response.status >= 400) {
  68| |        log.warn(payload);
  69| |      } else {
  70| |        log.info(payload);
  71| |      }
  73| |      return response;
  74| |    },
  75| |  };
  76| |};

>src/core/plugins/ratelimit.ts
l:../plugin|../context|../lru
e:RateLimitOptions|rateLimit
f:rateLimit(options: RateLimitOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:defaultKeyGenerator(ctx: FluxContext):string
f:getHeaders(entry: WindowEntry):Record<string, string>
t:RateLimitOptions
t:WindowEntry
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Rate limit plugin.
   3| | *
   4| | * Hardened:
   5| | * - does not trust x-forwarded-for unless trustProxy is enabled
   6| | */
   8| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   9| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
  10| |import { LRUCache } from "../lru";
  12|▼|export interface RateLimitOptions {
  13| |  windowMs?: number;
  14| |  maxRequests?: number;
  15| |  storeMax?: number;
  16| |  trustProxy?: boolean;
  17| |  keyGenerator?: (ctx: FluxContext) => string;
  18| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  19| |  message?: string;
  20| |}
  22|▼|interface WindowEntry {
  23| |  count: number;
  24| |  resetTime: number;
  25| |}
  27|▼|export const rateLimit = (options: RateLimitOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  28| |  const {
  29| |    windowMs = 60_000,
  30| |    maxRequests = 100,
  31| |    storeMax = 10_000,
  32| |    trustProxy = false,
  33| |    skip,
  34| |    message = "Too many requests",
  35| |  } = options;
  37|▼|  const defaultKeyGenerator = (ctx: FluxContext): string => {
  38| |    if (trustProxy) {
  39| |      const xff = ctx.headers.get("x-forwarded-for");
  40| |      if (xff) return xff.split(",")[0]?.trim() || "anonymous";
  41| |    }
  43| |    return ctx.headers.get("x-real-ip") || "anonymous";
  44| |  };
  46| |  const keyGenerator = options.keyGenerator ?? defaultKeyGenerator;
  48| |  const store = new LRUCache<string, WindowEntry>({
  49| |    max: storeMax,
  50| |    ttlMs: windowMs,
  51| |  });
  53|▼|  const getHeaders = (entry: WindowEntry): Record<string, string> => ({
  54| |    "X-RateLimit-Limit": String(maxRequests),
  55| |    "X-RateLimit-Remaining": String(Math.max(0, maxRequests - entry.count)),
  56| |    "X-RateLimit-Reset": String(Math.ceil(entry.resetTime / 1000)),
  57| |  });
  59| |  return {
  60| |    name: "rateLimit",
  62| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  63| |      if (skip?.(ctx)) return ctx;
  65| |      const key = keyGenerator(ctx);
  66| |      const now = Date.now();
  68| |      let entry = store.get(key);
  70| |      if (!entry || entry.resetTime <= now) {
  71| |        entry = { count: 0, resetTime: now + windowMs };
  72| |        store.set(key, entry, { ttlMs: windowMs });
  73| |      }
  75| |      entry.count++;
  77| |      store.set(key, entry, {
  78| |        ttlMs: Math.max(0, entry.resetTime - now),
  79| |      });
  81| |      if (entry.count > maxRequests) {
  82| |        return Response.json(
  83| |          { error: message },
  84| |          {
  85| |            status: 429,
  86| |            headers: {
  87| |              "content-type": "application/json",
  88| |              ...getHeaders(entry),
  89| |            },
  90| |          }
  91| |        );
  92| |      }
  94| |      ctx.setState("__ratelimit", entry);
  95| |      return ctx;
  96| |    },
  98| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  99| |      const entry = ctx.getState<WindowEntry>("__ratelimit");
 101| |      if (entry) {
 102| |        const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 104| |        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(getHeaders(entry))) {
 105| |          headers.set(k, v);
 106| |        }
 108| |        return new Response(response.body, {
 109| |          status: response.status,
 110| |          statusText: response.statusText,
 111| |          headers,
 112| |        });
 113| |      }
 115| |      return response;
 116| |    },
 117| |  };
 118| |};

>src/core/plugins/security.ts
l:../plugin
e:SecurityOptions|security
f:security(options: SecurityOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
t:SecurityOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Security Headers Plugin
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - no direct mutation of response headers
   6| | */
   8| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
  10|▼|export interface SecurityOptions {
  11| |  contentSecurityPolicy?: string | false;
  12| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy?: string | false;
  13| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy?: string | false;
  14| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy?: string | false;
  15| |  frameguard?: { action: "deny" | "sameorigin" } | false;
  16| |  hidePoweredBy?: boolean;
  17| |  hsts?: { maxAge?: number; includeSubDomains?: boolean; preload?: boolean } | false;
  18| |  noSniff?: boolean;
  19| |  referrerPolicy?: string | false;
  20| |  xssFilter?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |const DEFAULTS: SecurityOptions = {
  24| |  contentSecurityPolicy:
  25| |    "default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; font-src 'self' https: data:; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https: 'unsafe-inline'",
  26| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: "require-corp",
  27| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy: "same-origin",
  28| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy: "same-origin",
  29| |  frameguard: { action: "deny" },
  30| |  hidePoweredBy: true,
  31| |  hsts: { maxAge: 15552000, includeSubDomains: true, preload: true },
  32| |  noSniff: true,
  33| |  referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
  34| |  xssFilter: true,
  35| |};
  37|▼|export const security = (options: SecurityOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  38| |  const opts = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
  40| |  return {
  41| |    name: "security",
  42| |    onResponse(_ctx, response) {
  43| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  45| |      if (opts.contentSecurityPolicy)
  46| |        headers.set("Content-Security-Policy", opts.contentSecurityPolicy);
  48| |      if (opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy)
  49| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy", opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy);
  51| |      if (opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy)
  52| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy);
  54| |      if (opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy)
  55| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy);
  57| |      if (opts.frameguard)
  58| |        headers.set("X-Frame-Options", opts.frameguard.action.toUpperCase());
  60| |      if (opts.hidePoweredBy)
  61| |        headers.delete("X-Powered-By");
  63| |      if (opts.hsts) {
  64| |        let val = `max-age=${opts.hsts.maxAge ?? 15552000}`;
  65| |        if (opts.hsts.includeSubDomains) val += "; includeSubDomains";
  66| |        if (opts.hsts.preload) val += "; preload";
  67| |        headers.set("Strict-Transport-Security", val);
  68| |      }
  70| |      if (opts.noSniff)
  71| |        headers.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
  73| |      if (opts.referrerPolicy)
  74| |        headers.set("Referrer-Policy", opts.referrerPolicy);
  76| |      if (opts.xssFilter)
  77| |        headers.set("X-XSS-Protection", "0");
  79| |      return new Response(response.body, {
  80| |        status: response.status,
  81| |        statusText: response.statusText,
  82| |        headers,
  83| |      });
  84| |    },
  85| |  };
  86| |};
